items.titleZh: IFI44L启动子低甲基化作为系统性红斑狼疮的表观遗传生物标志物：系统评价和荟萃分析
items.abstractZh: 背景系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种异质性自身免疫性疾病，其特征是I型干扰素信号传导失调。表观遗传改变，特别是干扰素调节基因的DNA甲基化变化，已成为疾病诊断和分层的有前景的生物标志物。其中，IFI44L启动子低甲基化在SLE中被反复报道为最一致且最具疾病特异性的改变之一。目的系统评价IFI44L启动子甲基化在SLE中的证据，并通过荟萃分析方法定量综合其在不同人群中的表观遗传和诊断性能。方法对已发表文献进行系统检索，以确定报告SLE患者和对照组IFI44L启动子甲基化的研究。提取研究特征、种族、细胞类型、甲基化方向、CpG低/高甲基化计数。在不同种族和细胞类型中进行描述性分析。诊断性能汇总为受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线下的合并面积（AUC）。AUC估计值的方差使用Hanley-McNeil方法近似，并应用随机效应荟萃分析（DerSimonian-Laird）以考虑研究间异质性。结果纳入16个报告IFI44L启动子低甲基化的研究数据集。IFI44L启动子低甲基化在不同种族和生物样本类型中一致观察到。描述性亚组分析确定了不同种族、研究时期和甲基化分析方法的IFI44L启动子低甲基化程度的异质性，而根据生物样本类型的差异不太明显且未达到统计学显著性。在报告两种甲基化方向的研究中，低甲基化占主导地位。诊断AUC值在不同研究中有所变化，但很大程度上与样本量和低甲基化程度无关。合并曲线下面积（AUC）为0.74（95% CI 0.64-0.84），表明总体诊断性能中等。结论IFI44L启动子低甲基化代表了SLE在不同人群和研究设计中的显著且可复制的表观遗传特征。尽管甲基化程度存在变异性，但其诊断性能保持一致，支持IFI44L甲基化作为SLE的有前景的生物标志物。

items.title: Association between rheumatoid arthritis-interstitial lung disease and lung cancer: a two -sample Mendelian randomization study with East Asian genetic instruments.
items.abstract: Epidemiological studies consistently report an increased risk of lung cancer among rheumatoid arthritis patients. Proposed risk factors include male sex, smoking, and rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease. However, whether a direct genetic causal link exists between rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease and lung cancer remains unexplored. We used Mendelian randomization with East Asian genetic instruments to evaluate this relationship. We conducted a two-sample Mendelian randomization in which genetic instruments for rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease were derived from an East Asian GWAS (358 RA-ILD cases, 4 550 RA controls), and lung cancer associations were obtained from a cross-ancestry GWAS meta-analysis (20 378 cases, 18 696 controls). Causal effects were estimated using inverse-variance weighted, Mendelian randomization-Egger, and weighted median methods. Ten single nucleotide polymorphisms were identified as genetic instruments. Inverse-variance weighted analysis revealed no significant causal association between genetically predicted rheumatoid arthritis-associated interstitial lung disease and lung cancer (odds ratio = 1.00; 95% confidence interval: 0.99-1.01; p-value = 0.78). Sensitivity analyses showed no horizontal pleiotropy or heterogeneity. Our findings suggest that the severe lung complications of rheumatic arthritis do not inherently share a direct, genetically driven pathway with malignancy. The observed clinical risk may be explained by shared environmental factors, such as smoking, or chronic immune dysregulation, rather than inherent genetic pleiotropy, although further investigation is needed to clarify these mechanisms.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺病与肺癌的关联：一项使用东亚遗传工具的双样本孟德尔随机化研究
items.abstractZh: 流行病学研究一致报告类风湿关节炎患者肺癌风险增加。提出的危险因素包括男性、吸烟和类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺病。然而，类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺病与肺癌之间是否存在直接的遗传因果关联仍未探索。我们使用东亚遗传工具的孟德尔随机化来评估这种关系。我们进行了一项双样本孟德尔随机化，其中类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺病的遗传工具来自东亚GWAS（358例RA-ILD病例，4550例RA对照），肺癌关联来自跨祖先GWAS荟萃分析（20378例病例，18696例对照）。使用逆方差加权、孟德尔随机化-Egger和加权中位数方法估计因果效应。十个单核苷酸多态性被确定为遗传工具。逆方差加权分析显示，遗传预测的类风湿关节炎相关间质性肺病与肺癌之间无显著因果关联（比值比=1.00；95%置信区间：0.99-1.01；p值=0.78）。敏感性分析显示无水平多效性或异质性。我们的研究结果表明，类风湿关节炎的严重肺部并发症本身并不与恶性肿瘤共享直接的遗传驱动途径。观察到的临床风险可能由共享的环境因素（如吸烟）或慢性免疫失调解释，而非固有的遗传多效性，尽管需要进一步研究来阐明这些机制。

items.title: Impact of remission definitions on residual symptom burden assessed using the Okomarigoto Sheet in rheumatoid arthritis: a comparison between Boolean 1.0 and Boolean 2.0.
items.abstract: This study examined whether adopting the Boolean 2.0 remission criteria results in the inclusion of patients with a higher burden of residual symptoms (RS) in rheumatoid arthritis (RA). It also aimed to characterize differences in RS burden across remission definitions. This cross-sectional, single-center study included 400 consecutive patients with RA. RSs were assessed using the Okomarigoto Sheet (OS), which evaluates pain, morning stiffness, and fatigue. Clinical remission was defined using the Disease Activity Score in 28 joints with C-reactive protein (DAS28-CRP), Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI), Simplified Disease Activity Index (SDAI), and Boolean 1.0 and 2.0 criteria. The primary outcome was the proportion of patients achieving OS = 0. Mixed-effects logistic regression and subgroup analyses were conducted to compare RS burden across remission definitions. The proportion of patients achieving complete absence of RSs differed across remission definitions, with the highest rate observed in Boolean 1.0 remission (52.7%), followed by Boolean 2.0 (45.0%) and DAS28-CRP (37.5%). Compared with Boolean 1.0 remission, patients meeting Boolean 2.0 but not Boolean 1.0 criteria had significantly higher total and domain-specific OS scores (all p < 0.001). Similar findings were observed among patients achieving DAS28-CRP remission but not Boolean 1.0 remission. Mixed-effects logistic regression indicated no significant difference between Boolean 1.0 and Boolean 2.0 remission in achieving OS = 0. RS burden in RA varies depending on the remission definition. Boolean 2.0 remission expands the classification of remission and is associated with higher multidimensional residual symptom scores than Boolean 1.0 remission.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中缓解定义对使用Okomarigoto Sheet评估的残留症状负担的影响：Boolean 1.0与Boolean 2.0的比较
items.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了采用Boolean 2.0缓解标准是否会导致纳入具有更高残留症状（RS）负担的类风湿关节炎（RA）患者。同时旨在描述不同缓解定义下RS负担的差异。这项横断面、单中心研究纳入了400例连续的RA患者。使用Okomarigoto Sheet（OS）评估RS，该量表评估疼痛、晨僵和疲劳。临床缓解采用基于C反应蛋白的28关节疾病活动度评分（DAS28-CRP）、临床疾病活动指数（CDAI）、简化疾病活动指数（SDAI）以及Boolean 1.0和2.0标准定义。主要结局为达到OS=0的患者比例。采用混合效应逻辑回归和亚组分析比较不同缓解定义下的RS负担。达到完全无RS的患者比例在不同缓解定义间存在差异，其中Boolean 1.0缓解率最高（52.7%），其次为Boolean 2.0（45.0%）和DAS28-CRP（37.5%）。与Boolean 1.0缓解相比，达到Boolean 2.0但未达到Boolean 1.0标准的患者其总分和领域特异性OS评分显著更高（所有p < 0.001）。在达到DAS28-CRP缓解但未达到Boolean 1.0缓解的患者中也观察到类似发现。混合效应逻辑回归显示，在达到OS=0方面，Boolean 1.0和Boolean 2.0缓解之间无显著差异。RA中的RS负担因缓解定义而异。Boolean 2.0缓解扩大了缓解的分类，并与比Boolean 1.0缓解更高的多维残留症状评分相关。

items.title: PPI-Refractory GERD in systemic sclerosis is driven by distinct esophageal and gastric motility abnormalities.
items.abstract: Gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) is highly prevalent in systemic sclerosis (SSc) and frequently persists despite proton pump inhibitor (PPI) therapy. We aimed to characterize the contribution of esophageal and gastric dysmotility to PPI-refractory GERD in SSc. We conducted a single‑centre, retrospective study of adults with SSc who underwent ambulatory pH-multichannel intraluminal impedance (pH/MII) monitoring while receiving twice‑daily PPI therapy (2021-2025). Esophageal motility (high‑resolution manometry, HREM) and gastric emptying scintigraphy were integrated to examine associations between gastro-esophageal dysmotility and reflux phenotypes. Thirty patients were included, of whom 67% had PPI-refractory reflux symptoms and 33% were undergoing pre-lung transplantation evaluation. Refractory GERD was present in 29/30 patients (97%) based on Lyon 2.0 classification, with conclusive evidence in 53% and borderline evidence in 43%. Esophageal dysmotility was identified in 80%, most commonly absent contractility (67%), and was associated with impaired reflux clearance, reflected by longer acid clearance times (2.20 [1.15-3.75] vs 1.15 [0.43-1.90] min) and prolonged reflux episode duration (16.60 [4.38-40.63] vs 1.95 [0.53-20.43] min). Gastric dysmotility was identified in 60.7% and was associated with an increased reflux episode burden (51.00 [30.00-81.50] vs 25.00 [21.00-54.00] episodes/24h). PPI‑refractory GERD is nearly universal in this SSc cohort and reflects heterogeneous, quantifiable abnormalities across the foregut, including impaired esophageal clearance and increased reflux burden related to gastric retention. These findings support integrated physiologic evaluation to define reflux mechanisms, inform risk stratification (including lung transplantation), and guide targeted, mechanism-based therapies beyond acid suppression.

items.title: Different age, different phenotype: a comparative analysis of juvenile and adult-onset dermatomyositis from a tertiary center.
items.abstract: To evaluate age-related differences in clinical features, serological profiles, diagnostic approaches, treatment strategies, and outcomes among juvenile- and adult-onset dermatomyositis (JDM and AoDM) patients managed at the same tertiary referral center. This retrospective cohort included 180 patients with dermatomyositis meeting the 2017 EULAR/ACR classification criteria and followed between 1995 and 2025 at the pediatric and adult rheumatology clinics. Diagnosis before 16 years was classified as JDM. Among 180 patients, 86 had JDM and 94 had AoDM. A bimodal age distribution was observed, with peaks at 6.8 and 45.7 years. 67.8% were female; median follow-up was 5.9 years. Muscle weakness (86.7%) and cutaneous involvement (98.3%) were most common findings. Calcinosis was frequent in JDM (33%) but rare in adults (one case). Both calcinosis and arthritis were significantly associated with JDM (p = 0.007 and p = 0.049). Anti-NXP2 was the leading JDM autoantibody (31.4%, 11/35), whereas anti-synthetase antibodies (34.6%, 9/26) in AoDM. Glucocorticoids were given to both groups; however, steroid-free (40.3% vs 89.6%, p = 0.020) and drug-free remission rates (40.3% vs 16.7%, p = 0.020) were higher in JDM. Malignancy-associated dermatomyositis occurred only in AoDM (n = 25, 26.6%). Age at diagnosis was independently associated with both mortality (OR 1.07 per year, 95% CI 1.02-1.11) and malignancy (OR 1.05 per year, 95% CI 1.00-1.10). JDM and AoDM are not merely age-defined variants but display distinct clinical, serological, and prognostic profiles. JDM shows calcinosis and better remission and survival, whereas AoDM is strongly associated with malignancy and higher mortality burden, highlighting the need for age‑tailored diagnostic and management strategies.

items.titleZh: 不同年龄，不同表型：来自三级中心的青少年与成人发病皮肌炎比较分析
items.abstractZh: 旨在评估在同一三级转诊中心管理的青少年发病皮肌炎（JDM）和成人发病皮肌炎（AoDM）患者在临床特征、血清学谱、诊断方法、治疗策略和结局方面的年龄相关差异。这项回顾性队列纳入了180例符合2017年EULAR/ACR分类标准并在1995年至2025年间于儿科和成人风湿病门诊随访的皮肌炎患者。16岁前诊断被归类为JDM。在180例患者中，86例为JDM，94例为AoDM。观察到双峰年龄分布，峰值分别为6.8岁和45.7岁。67.8%为女性；中位随访时间为5.9年。肌无力（86.7%）和皮肤受累（98.3%）是最常见的表现。钙质沉着在JDM中常见（33%），但在成人中罕见（1例）。钙质沉着和关节炎均与JDM显著相关（p = 0.007和p = 0.049）。抗NXP2是JDM的主要自身抗体（31.4%，11/35），而抗合成酶抗体在AoDM中为主（34.6%，9/26）。两组均给予糖皮质激素；然而，JDM的无激素缓解率（40.3% vs 89.6%，p = 0.020）和无药物缓解率（40.3% vs 16.7%，p = 0.020）更高。恶性肿瘤相关性皮肌炎仅发生在AoDM中（n = 25，26.6%）。诊断年龄与死亡率（每岁OR 1.07，95% CI 1.02-1.11）和恶性肿瘤（每岁OR 1.05，95% CI 1.00-1.10）均独立相关。JDM和AoDM不仅仅是按年龄定义的变体，而是表现出不同的临床、血清学和预后特征。JDM表现为钙质沉着和更好的缓解及生存，而AoDM与恶性肿瘤和更高的死亡负担密切相关，强调需要针对年龄定制诊断和管理策略。

items.title: Systematic review of fatigue assessment instruments for systemic lupus erythematosus: psychometric validation with COSMIN 2.0 Guidelines.
items.abstract: To identify and evaluate the methodological quality and psychometric properties of patient-reported outcome measures (PROMs) for fatigue assessment in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) patients. A systematic search was performed across eight databases (PubMed, EMBASE, Web of Science, CINAHL, CNKI, WanFang, VIP, SinoMed) from inception to June 12, 2026. Eligible studies focused on developing/psychometrically validating SLE fatigue-specific PROMs with explicit reporting of at least one psychometric property. Study methodological quality and PROM psychometric performance were assessed in accordance with COSMIN 2.0 guidelines; measurement property evidence for each PROM was synthesized across eligible studies, and evidence certainty evaluated via a modified Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development and Evaluation(GRADE)system. Fifteen studies involving six distinct PROMs were included. No instrument was conclusively recommendable for clinical practice/research due to insufficient high-certainty evidence, particularly for cross-cultural validity/measurement invariance and criterion validity. The Functional Assessment of Chronic Illness Therapy-Fatigue (FACIT-Fatigue) was the most promising, with high-quality evidence for five core psychometric properties (content validity, structural validity, internal consistency, construct validity hypothesis testing, responsiveness), and it assesses physical/mental fatigue and their impacts on functional status and daily living. A critical gap exists in fully validated, high-quality SLE-specific PROMs for fatigue assessment. FACIT-Fatigue is the most viable tool for this population but requires further rigorous psychometric validation. Future research should prioritize comprehensive validation of FACIT-Fatigue (e.g., supplementing cross-cultural and criterion validity evidence) and the development/validation of SLE-specific PROMs to quantify fatigue and its disease-specific manifestations. PROSPERO (CRD420251272840).

items.title: Effectiveness of biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs in progressive pulmonary fibrosis associated with rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: To evaluate the effectiveness and safety of biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (bDMARDs) in rheumatoid arthritis (RA)-associated progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF). Real-world data were retrospectively collected in RA-associated PPF during the first year after bDMARD initiation. The primary outcome was change in pulmonary function and computed tomography (CT) visual scores at week 52. The secondary outcomes included comparisons of pulmonary function, CT scores, Clinical Disease Activity Index (CDAI), drug retention rates, and adverse event rates over 52 weeks among the tumour necrosis factor inhibitor (TNFi), cytotoxic T-lymphocyte-associated antigen 4 immunoglobulin (CTLA4-Ig), and interleukin-6 receptor inhibitor (IL-6Ri), using propensity score-based inverse probability of treatment weighting (PS-IPTW). Among 2,484 patients with RA initiating bDMARDs, 443 had RA-associated interstitial lung disease (ILD), and 135 had RA-associated PPF (TNFi, n = 35; CTLA4-Ig, n = 45; IL-6Ri, n = 55). Treatment with bDMARDs markedly improved CDAI at week 52, and pulmonary function and CT scores remained stable. PS-IPTW-adjusted comparisons showed no significant differences in CDAI, CT scores, or drug retention rates among the bDMARD groups. However, forced vital capacity (FVC) improved in IL-6Ri compared with TNFi (-3.2% vs + 3.3%, p = 0.011; Cohen's d = 0.630). Adverse events were less frequent in CTLA4-Ig. Multivariate logistic regression analysis identified IL-6Ri treatment, non-usual interstitial pneumonia (UIP) pattern, and lower CDAI at week 52 as independent predictors of FVC improvement. Tight control of RA disease activity with bDMARDs appears crucial in RA-associated PPF. In this real-world comparative study, IL-6Ri may have contributed to improved FVC, whereas CTLA4-Ig may have a favourable safety profile.

items.title: Describing flares: A mixed methods study comparing patient and clinician perspectives in systemic lupus erythematosus and other rheumatic diseases.
items.abstract: Systemic autoimmune rheumatic diseases (SARDs) relapse and remit, with periods of increased disease activity called "flares". This study compared patient and clinician perspectives of flares. Mixed-methods approach combining an international co-produced survey and in-depth interviews. SLE patients and clinicians rated statements about flares on Likert scales from "never" to "always". Quantitative data were analysed using t-tests and ANOVA. Patient and clinician interviews were analysed thematically. Quantitative and qualitative analyses were triangulated by exploring converging, diverging and explanatory findings across the datasets. Qualitative (N = 31 SARD patients, N = 12 clinicians) and quantitative (N = 443 SLE patients, N = 258 clinicians) results indicated differential patient and clinician perspectives. The main themes identified were: characteristics/consequences of flares; recognition of flares; and treatment for flares (medical and/or self-management). Patients and clinicians had significantly different mean ratings for 12/17 flare statements. Notably, regarding flare onset, 39% of patients compared to 14% of clinicians said flares "often" or "always" started within minutes or hours (p < 0·001). We found differences in identification of flares, with patients rating "patient can tell" significantly higher than clinicians (p<·001), including awareness of prodromal symptoms. Clinicians were significantly more likely to think flares required increased (p = 0·005) or new (p<·001) medication. There was consensus about the impact of flares on wellbeing. We highlight differences in how SARD patients and clinicians describe flares, notably related to onset, recognition and intervention. These differences challenge the prevailing reliance on clinician-derived disease activity measures and biomarkers for flare assessment, highlighting the need for integration of patient and clinician perspectives.

items.titleZh: 描述发作：一项比较系统性红斑狼疮及其他风湿病患者与临床医生观点的混合方法研究
items.abstractZh: 系统性自身免疫性风湿病（SARDs）会复发和缓解，其中疾病活动性增加的时期被称为“发作”。本研究比较了患者和临床医生对发作的看法。采用混合方法，结合国际共同设计的调查和深度访谈。SLE患者和临床医生对关于发作的陈述按李克特量表从“从不”到“总是”进行评分。定量数据使用t检验和ANOVA进行分析。患者和临床医生的访谈按主题进行分析。通过探索数据集之间趋同、分歧和解释性的发现，对定量和定性分析进行了三角验证。定性（N = 31名SARD患者，N = 12名临床医生）和定量（N = 443名SLE患者，N = 258名临床医生）结果表明患者和临床医生的观点存在差异。确定的主要主题为：发作的特征/后果；发作的识别；以及发作的治疗（药物和/或自我管理）。患者和临床医生在17项发作陈述中有12项的平均评分存在显著差异。值得注意的是，关于发作的起始，39%的患者与14%的临床医生表示发作“经常”或“总是”在几分钟或几小时内开始（p < 0·001）。我们发现发作识别存在差异，患者对“患者能判断”的评分显著高于临床医生（p<·001），包括对前驱症状的察觉。临床医生显著更可能认为发作需要增加（p = 0·005）或新用（p<·001）药物。关于发作对健康的影响存在共识。我们强调了SARD患者和临床医生描述发作的差异，特别是与起始、识别和干预相关的方面。这些差异挑战了目前依赖临床医生得出的疾病活动度测量和生物标志物来评估发作的做法，凸显了整合患者和临床医生观点的必要性。

items.title: Comparison of cardiovascular diseases risk awareness, physical activity, nutritional habits and cardiovascular risks in female patients with rheumatoid arthritis and knee osteoarthritis: A cross-sectional study.
items.abstract: Background and ObjectiveBoth rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and knee osteoarthritis (KOA) are associated with increased cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) risk. Although lifestyle factors have been studied in these patients, data directly comparing CVDs risk awareness between RA and KOA remain limited. Therefore, this study aimed to compare CVDs awareness, physical activity, nutritional habits, and cardiovascular risk factors between female patients with RA and KOA.MethodsFemale patients aged ≥40 years with RA, diagnosed according to the 2010 ACR/EULAR-classification criteria, or KOA, diagnosed according to the ACR-classification criteria, were enrolled. Demographic data and comorbidities were recorded. CVDs risk awareness was assessed using the Cardiovascular Disease Risk Factors Knowledge Level (CARRF-KL) Scale, physical activity using the International Physical Activity Questionnaire (IPAQ)-Short Form, eating habits using the Nutrition Attitudes Scale (NAS), and CVDs risk using the Framingham Risk Score (FRS).ResultsThe study was completed with 60 RA and 60 KOA patients. Age, weight, and presence of diabetes were significantly higher in KOA group (p < 0.001, p = 0.032, and p = 0.039,respectively), and exercise habits were significantly lower in RA group compared to KOA group(p = 0.008). There was no significant difference between the CARRF-KL and NAS groups (p = 0.629, p = 0.094, respectively). In contrast to exercise habits, IPAQ scores were significantly lower in KOA group than in RA group(p = 0.019). Furthermore, the FRS was significantly higher in KOA group (p = 0.026).ConclusionAlthough CVDs risk awareness was similar between RA and KOA patients, cardiovascular risk was higher in KOA group. Assessment of cardiovascular risk and lifestyle-related factors may contribute to improved preventive strategies in these patients.

items.titleZh: 女性类风湿关节炎与膝骨关节炎患者心血管疾病风险意识、体力活动、营养习惯及心血管风险的比较：一项横断面研究。
items.abstractZh: 背景与目的类风湿关节炎（RA）和膝骨关节炎（KOA）均与心血管疾病（CVDs）风险增加相关。尽管已对这些患者的生活方式因素进行了研究，但直接比较RA和KOA患者CVDs风险意识的数据仍然有限。因此，本研究旨在比较女性RA与KOA患者的CVDs意识、体力活动、营养习惯和心血管危险因素。方法纳入年龄≥40岁、根据2010年ACR/EULAR-分类标准诊断为RA或根据ACR-分类标准诊断为KOA的女性患者。记录人口统计学数据和合并症。使用心血管疾病危险因素知识水平（CARRF-KL）量表评估CVDs风险意识，使用国际体力活动问卷（IPAQ）-短版评估体力活动，使用营养态度量表（NAS）评估饮食习惯，使用Framingham风险评分（FRS）评估CVDs风险。结果研究共完成60例RA和60例KOA患者。KOA组的年龄、体重和糖尿病患病率显著高于RA组（分别为p < 0.001、p = 0.032和p = 0.039），而RA组的运动习惯显著低于KOA组（p = 0.008）。CARRF-KL和NAS组间无显著差异（分别为p = 0.629、p = 0.094）。与运动习惯相反，KOA组的IPAQ评分显著低于RA组（p = 0.019）。此外，KOA组的FRS显著更高（p = 0.026）。结论尽管RA和KOA患者的CVDs风险意识相似，但KOA组的心血管风险更高。评估心血管风险和生活方式相关因素可能有助于改善这些患者的预防策略。

items.title: Interstitial Lung Disease Induced by Monoclonal Antibodies for Psoriatic Arthritis, a Double Hit: A Case Report with a Literature and Clinical Trial Review.
items.abstract: Monoclonal antibodies (mAb) play a central role in modern medicine; however, several of them have been associated with the development of drug-induced interstitial lung diseases (ILD). We present a case of a patient affected by psoriatic arthritis (PsA) treated with secukinumab, an anti-IL17 mAb, who developed a histological organising pneumonia pattern with microgranulomas. After resolution, the patient relapsed when exposed to guselkumab, an anti-IL23 mAb, with further histological confirmation. Treatment withdrawal and steroids resolved the ILD in both cases. To evaluate the risk of developing ILD in the context of those two drugs, we also performed a review of the literature and the clinical trials for the drugs in PsA. Papers presenting drug-induced ILD in patients treated with secukinumab and/or guselkumab in PubMed and Embase were searched and summarised. Respiratory-related adverse events reported in secukinumab and guselkumab clinical trials for PsA were summarised. We summarised seven papers, finding a rare presentation (between 0.1% and 0.5%) of ILD in the treated population. The majority of the patients resolved the ILD after treatment withdrawal, with or without steroid treatment. In the clinical trials, respiratory-related adverse events were rarely reported, with only one case of ILD and one case of interstitial abnormalities at CT scan. This is the first case, to the best of our knowledge, that experienced a double hit from two different mAbs used for the treatment of PsA, secukinumab and guselkumab. Summarising the available literature and the reported adverse events for these two drugs, we also describe how, even in rare cases, mAbs in the context of PsA should raise suspicion of ILDs whenever the patient exhibits new respiratory symptoms.

items.titleZh: 单克隆抗体诱导的银屑病关节炎相关间质性肺病，双重打击：病例报告及文献与临床试验综述
items.abstractZh: 单克隆抗体（mAb）在现代医学中发挥核心作用；然而，其中一些与药物诱导的间质性肺病（ILD）的发生相关。我们报告一例银屑病关节炎（PsA）患者，接受抗IL17单克隆抗体司库奇尤单抗治疗后，出现组织学上机化性肺炎伴微肉芽肿的模式。病情缓解后，患者在使用抗IL23单克隆抗体古塞奇尤单抗时复发，并再次获得组织学确认。停用药物及使用类固醇治疗在两种情况下均使ILD消退。为评估这两种药物在PsA背景下发生ILD的风险，我们还对文献及针对PsA的药物临床试验进行了综述。检索并总结了PubMed和Embase中关于司库奇尤单抗和/或古塞奇尤单抗治疗患者出现药物诱导ILD的论文。总结了司库奇尤单抗和古塞奇尤单抗在PsA临床试验中报告的呼吸系统相关不良事件。我们总结了七篇论文，发现治疗人群中ILD的罕见表现（介于0.1%至0.5%之间）。大多数患者在停药后ILD消退，无论是否使用类固醇治疗。在临床试验中，呼吸系统相关不良事件很少报告，仅有一例ILD和一例CT扫描显示间质性异常。据我们所知，这是首例因两种不同mAb（司库奇尤单抗和古塞奇尤单抗）治疗PsA而经历双重打击的病例。总结现有文献及这两种药物报告的不良事件，我们还描述了即使在罕见情况下，当患者出现新的呼吸系统症状时，PsA背景下的mAb也应引起对ILD的怀疑。

items.title: Peripheral bone erosion and atlantoaxial instability as factors associated with pannus formation in rheumatoid arthritis: a cross-sectional risk stratification study.
items.abstract: Clinical and radiologic predictors of atlantoaxial pannus formation in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) remain unidentified. We aimed to develop a risk stratification model using routinely collected data. Our cohort comprised 242 RA patients evaluated with cervical magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) at Hanyang University Medical Center (2005 to 2015). Pannus was assessed on midsagittal T1-weighted sequences. We examined 16 candidate variables covering demographics, radiographic measurements, serology, and medication; chained-equation multiple imputation handled missing values. A parsimonious logistic regression model (bone erosion, anterior atlanto-dens interval (ADI), and age; events per variable 20.3) served as the primary analysis. Fivefold cross-validated area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) measured discrimination; 200 bootstrap resamples quantified overfitting, and calibration was assessed by the Hosmer-Lemeshow test. We identified pannus in 61 of 242 patients (25.2%). Bone erosion dominated, odds ratio 6.47 (95% confidence interval 3.18 to 13.16, P < 0.001). Cross-validated AUC for the parsimonious model reached 0.768 (optimism-corrected 0.769), and calibration was satisfactory (Hosmer-Lemeshow P = 0.575). A two-factor stratification by bone erosion and ADI separated subgroups whose pannus rates spanned 6.0% (95% CI 2.6% to 13.2%) to 45.7% (95% CI 34.6% to 57.3%; Cochran-Armitage trend P < 0.001). Bone erosion on hand and foot radiographs outperformed all 15 competing variables in each of the three analytic frameworks applied. Pairing the erosion finding with ADI values obtained from lateral cervical films produces a clinically transparent risk classification; this two-variable scheme may guide decisions on cervical MRI referral. Key Points • Peripheral bone erosion on hand and foot radiographs was the factor most strongly associated with atlantoaxial pannus in 242 rheumatoid arthritis patients (OR 6.47, P < 0.001). • A parsimonious logistic regression model (bone erosion, ADI, age) achieved a cross-validated AUC of 0.768 with good calibration. • A two-factor stratification separated subgroups with pannus rates of 6.0% (95% CI 2.6% to 13.2%) to 45.7% (95% CI 34.6% to 57.3%) (Cochran-Armitage P < 0.001), a clinically actionable risk gradient from routine plain radiographs.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中与外周骨侵蚀和寰枢椎不稳相关的血管翳形成因素：一项横断面风险分层研究
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）中寰枢椎血管翳形成的临床和影像学预测因素尚未明确。我们旨在利用常规收集的数据开发一种风险分层模型。我们的队列包括242例在汉阳大学医学中心（2005年至2015年）接受颈椎磁共振成像（MRI）评估的RA患者。在中矢状T1加权序列上评估血管翳。我们检查了涵盖人口统计学、影像学测量、血清学和药物治疗的16个候选变量；链式方程多重插补处理缺失值。一个简约逻辑回归模型（骨侵蚀、寰齿前间距（ADI）和年龄；每变量事件数20.3）作为主要分析。五折交叉验证的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）衡量判别能力；200次bootstrap重采样量化过拟合，并通过Hosmer-Lemeshow检验评估校准。我们在242例患者中识别出61例（25.2%）有血管翳。骨侵蚀占主导，比值比为6.47（95%置信区间3.18至13.16，P < 0.001）。简约模型的交叉验证AUC达到0.768（乐观校正后0.769），校准令人满意（Hosmer-Lemeshow P = 0.575）。通过骨侵蚀和ADI的两因素分层将亚组分开，其血管翳发生率范围为6.0%（95% CI 2.6%至13.2%）至45.7%（95% CI 34.6%至57.3%；Cochran-Armitage趋势P < 0.001）。手部和足部X线片上的骨侵蚀在应用的三种分析框架中均优于所有15个竞争变量。将骨侵蚀发现与侧位颈椎片获得的ADI值配对，可产生临床透明的风险分类；这一两变量方案可能指导颈椎MRI转诊决策。关键点 • 手部和足部X线片上的外周骨侵蚀是与242例类风湿关节炎患者寰枢椎血管翳相关性最强的因素（OR 6.47，P < 0.001）。 • 一个简约逻辑回归模型（骨侵蚀、ADI、年龄）实现了0.768的交叉验证AUC，且校准良好。 • 两因素分层将亚组分开，血管翳发生率范围为6.0%（95% CI 2.6%至13.2%）至45.7%（95% CI 34.6%至57.3%）（Cochran-Armitage P < 0.001），这是来自常规平片的临床可操作风险梯度。

items.title: Circulating levels of TL1A and its decoy receptor DcR3 in systemic sclerosis.
items.abstract: Tumor necrosis factor-like cytokine 1A (TL1A, TNFSF15) is a profibrotic and proinflammatory cytokine. Experimental evidence implicates TL1A-mediated interactions in interstitial lung disease (ILD); such interactions are disrupted by decoy receptor 3 (DcR3) binding to TL1A. We examined the potential clinical value of circulating TL1A and DcR3 levels in systemic sclerosis (SSc). Consecutive unselected patients with SSc (n = 41) of varying disease duration, severity, and treatment modalities; individuals with primary Raynaud's phenomenon (pRP) (n = 52); and apparently healthy individuals (n = 49) were studied. Serum TL1A and DcR3 levels were measured by ELISA. TL1A levels were increased in SSc patients compared to healthy individuals whereas DcR3 levels were increased in SSc compared to both pRP and healthy individuals (all p < 0.001). Clinical features, pulmonary function tests, and treatment modalities were analyzed at baseline and annually for two consecutive years. Using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis and the MINIMISE endpoint for mortality and morbidity we found that baseline serum levels of DcR3, but not TL1A, were predictive of SSc progression over 2 years (AUC = 0.684, p = 0.04). While no associations between TL1A levels and disease characteristics were noted, patients with DcR3 levels above the ROC-defined cut-off had significantly higher erythrocyte sedimentation rate, higher prevalence of ILD confirmed by high resolution chest computed tomography, and lower diffusion capacity for carbon monoxide. Increased circulating DcR3 levels are associated with SSc-ILD in unselected patients and may serve as a biomarker of disease progression. Further studies are needed to explore the clinical value in selected SSc patient subgroups. Keypoints • TL1A and DcR3 are elevated in the serum of patients with systemic sclerosis. • DcR3 levels are associated with SSc-ILD and higher systemic inflammation. • Circulating DcR3 levels may serve as a prognostic biomarker in SSc.

items.title: Factors associated with shorter time to death and causes of mortality among deceased patients with systemic sclerosis: a multicentre retrospective study.
items.abstract: To describe causes of death and identify clinical factors associated with shorter time to death among deceased patients with systemic sclerosis (SSc) in Turkey. This retrospective multicentre study screened hospital databases across 19 tertiary rheumatology centres between 2004 and 2024 for deceased patients aged ≥16 years with ICD-10 codes beginning with M34. Eligibility was confirmed according to the 2013 American College of Rheumatology/European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology classification criteria; 266 of 294 identified patients were included. Dates of death were verified through the national death registry. Baseline clinical features, organ involvement, and key echocardiographic measures were extracted from medical records. Time to death was defined as the interval from diagnosis to death. Cause-specific Cox regression models were constructed for SSc-related and non-SSc-related deaths. Of 266 deaths, 122 (45.9%) were SSc related and 144 (54.1%) non-SSc related. Among SSc-related deaths, interstitial lung disease (ILD) (50.0%, n = 61) and pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) (42.6%, n = 52) predominated. Among non-SSc-related deaths, cardiovascular causes (38.9%, n = 56), infections (33.3%, n = 48), and malignancy (19.4%, n = 28) were most frequent. In multivariable models, older age at diagnosis, scleroderma renal crisis, palpitations, ILD, and higher echocardiographic pulmonary artery systolic pressure were independently associated with shorter time to SSc-related death, whereas older age at diagnosis and malignancy were associated with shorter time to non-SSc-related death. Pulmonary complications predominated among SSc-related deaths, whereas cardiovascular disease, infections, and malignancy were the leading contributors to non-SSc-related mortality. These findings support systematic cardiopulmonary assessment and comorbidity management.

items.titleZh: 与系统性硬化症死亡患者较短死亡时间相关的因素及死亡原因：一项多中心回顾性研究。
items.abstractZh: 旨在描述土耳其系统性硬化症（SSc）死亡患者的死亡原因，并确定与较短死亡时间相关的临床因素。这项回顾性多中心研究筛选了2004年至2024年间19个三级风湿病中心医院数据库中年龄≥16岁、ICD-10编码以M34开头的死亡患者。根据2013年美国风湿病学会/欧洲风湿病联盟分类标准确认资格；294名确定患者中纳入了266名。死亡日期通过国家死亡登记处核实。从医疗记录中提取基线临床特征、器官受累和关键超声心动图指标。死亡时间定义为从诊断到死亡的时间间隔。针对SSc相关和非SSc相关死亡构建了原因特异性Cox回归模型。在266例死亡中，122例（45.9%）为SSc相关，144例（54.1%）为非SSc相关。在SSc相关死亡中，间质性肺病（ILD）（50.0%，n=61）和肺动脉高压（PAH）（42.6%，n=52）占主导。在非SSc相关死亡中，心血管原因（38.9%，n=56）、感染（33.3%，n=48）和恶性肿瘤（19.4%，n=28）最为常见。在多变量模型中，诊断时年龄较大、硬皮病肾危象、心悸、ILD和超声心动图肺动脉收缩压较高与SSc相关死亡时间较短独立相关，而诊断时年龄较大和恶性肿瘤与非SSc相关死亡时间较短相关。肺部并发症在SSc相关死亡中占主导，而心血管疾病、感染和恶性肿瘤是非SSc相关死亡率的主要贡献因素。这些发现支持系统性的心肺评估和合并症管理。

items.title: Abatacept Reduces CD319+ (SLAMF7) Cytotoxic T Cells and Cytokine Production in Systemic Sclerosis.
items.abstract: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is characterized by immune dysregulation and fibrosis. We investigated whether abatacept modulates CD319/SLAMF7-expressing cytotoxic T cells implicated in diffuse cutaneous SSc. In this ancillary ASSET trial analysis, PBMCs from 67 participants were analyzed at baseline and months 1, 3, and 6. Flow cytometry quantified CD4+CD319+ and CD8+CD319+ T cells, cytotoxic/activation markers, and stimulated intracellular IL-4, IL-17A, and IFN-γ. Analyses compared abatacept-treated molecular endotypes with placebo and related immune changes to modified Rodnan skin score (mRSS) change. Skin single-cell RNA sequencing included 5 healthy controls and 8 SSc patients. At baseline, CD319+ T cells showed greater cytokine production, activation, and granzyme/perforin expression than CD319- T cells in 60 evaluable participants (p<0.001 to p<0.0001). Abatacept reduced CD4+CD319+ and CD8+CD319+ T cell frequencies at month 6; placebo did not. Effects were strongest in fibroproliferative patients, where CD8+CD319+ T cells decreased versus placebo (n=7 versus n=36; p=0.0377). In this endotype, abatacept reduced IL-4 in CD4+CD319+ and CD8+CD319+ T cells at month 3 (p=0.0468 and p=0.0287) and IL-17A in CD8+CD319+ T cells at month 6 (p=0.0004), while IFN-γ was unchanged. Reduction in CD4+CD319+ T cells correlated with mRSS improvement in abatacept-treated patients (r=0.5297, p=0.0423). Skin single-cell RNA-sequencing showed increased SLAMF7 expression in SSc T cells (p=0.017), enriched within cytotoxic subsets. CD319+ T cells represent highly differentiated, activated cytotoxic effector populations in SSc. Abatacept selectively modulates these cells and suppresses associated pro-fibrotic and pro-inflammatory cytokines, particularly in the fibroproliferative subtype, where CD319+ T cell reductions correlate with clinical improvement.

items.title: Interstitial palladin is associated with tubulointerstitial chronicity and adverse outcomes in patients with lupus nephritis.
items.abstract: BackgroundTubulointerstitial lesions predict kidney prognosis in lupus nephritis (LN), but the molecular features of interstitial fibrosis remain incompletely defined. We previously showed that palladin, an actin-associated protein, drives kidney fibrosis through actin dynamics. This study examined whether interstitial palladin expression is associated with histopathology and prognosis in LN.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed Japanese patients with biopsy-proven LN at Kanazawa University Hospital between 1990 and 2018. Palladin-positive area was quantified by immunohistochemistry and log2-transformed (log2 palladin). The colocalization of palladin and α-smooth muscle actin (αSMA) was investigated by immunofluorescence. Associations with modified NIH activity and chronicity indices were assessed using Spearman correlation. Event-free survival for renal replacement therapy (RRT) initiation or all-cause death was evaluated by Kaplan-Meier analysis.ResultsThirty-four patients were included. Palladin was predominantly expressed in the kidney interstitium and colocalized with αSMA-positive cells. Log2 palladin correlated with the modified NIH chronicity index (ρ = 0.61, p < 0.01), tubular atrophy (ρ = 0.53, p < 0.01), interstitial fibrosis (ρ = 0.56, p < 0.01), and interstitial inflammation (ρ = 0.55, p < 0.01), but not with the total activity index (ρ = 0.24, p = 0.16). During a median follow-up of 10.1 years (IQR, 3.3-17.5), seven patients reached the composite outcome. The composite outcome occurred in five patients in the high-palladin group and two patients in the low-palladin group, and high palladin expression was associated with poorer event-free survival by Kaplan-Meier analysis (log-rank p = 0.04).ConclusionInterstitial palladin expression may reflect tubulointerstitial chronicity and be associated with poor outcomes in LN; however, its independent prognostic value could not be established due to the limited number of events.

items.title: ROS-Sensitive Hydrogel With Methotrexate-ss-Oxidized Bletilla striata Polysaccharide Nanoparticles for the Enhanced Treatment of Rheumatoid Arthritis.
items.abstract: Remodeling the immune microenvironment and scavenging excess reactive oxygen species (ROS) are considered effective strategies for treating rheumatoid arthritis (RA). Methotrexate (MTX), a first-line drug, can correct the imbalance between helper T-cell type 17 and regulatory T cells (Th17/Treg) and inhibit the proliferation and migration of fibroblast-like synoviocytes (FLSs). However, it lacks antioxidant and macrophage regulatory functions, is prone to systemic toxicity, and has poor solubility. In this study, MTX and oxidized Bletilla striata polysaccharide (OBSP) were conjugated and self-assembled into MTX-ss-OBSP NPs via disulfide bonds to integrate macrophage-polarizing and antioxidant activities. These nanoparticles were loaded into a novel ROS-responsive oxidized hyaluronic acid-3-aminophenylboronic acid-hyaluronic acid (OHA-PBA-HA) hydrogel, yielding MTX-ss-OBSP NPs@OHA-PBA-HA. This injectable hydrogel exhibits ROS-triggered drug release, reduces ROS levels, promotes M2 macrophage polarization, and modulates cytokine secretion (decreasing IL-6/TNF-α; increasing IL-10). In vivo experiments demonstrated that the hydrogel blocks bone erosion, inhibits synovial inflammation, protects cartilage, and regulates M1/M2 and Th17/Treg balances while significantly reducing MTX-induced hepatotoxicity and nephrotoxicity. Compared with free MTX, this nanoparticle-loaded hydrogel accelerates the resolution of RA inflammation with superior safety. Therefore, this responsive hydrogel system represents a promising candidate for clinical RA treatment by integrating immune remodeling and antioxidant therapy.

items.title: NOX2 deficiency exacerbates lupus nephritis through activation of NLRP3 inflammasome in neutrophils.
items.abstract: Lupus nephritis (LN) is a severe manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) associated with significant morbidity. Although reduced production of reactive oxygen species (ROS) by neutrophils correlates with severe SLE, the specific mechanisms linking ROS deficiency to heightened renal inflammation remain unknown. We aimed to elucidate the role of NOX2-derived ROS in LN pathogenesis and identify potential therapeutic targets. We conducted an in vivo study using a pristane-induced lupus model in Ncf1 -/- (NOX2-deficient) mice and wild-type controls. We assessed LN severity and characterized renal immune infiltration using flow cytometry and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq). We performed transcriptomic analysis to evaluate the function of NOX2-deficient neutrophils. Finally, we tested the therapeutic efficacy of an IL-1 receptor antagonist in ameliorating disease severity in the NOX2-deficient mice. NOX2 deficiency exacerbated LN severity compared to wild-type controls, demonstrated by increased serum anti-dsDNA antibody titers and worsened LN scores. Through scRNA-seq, we identified a distinct, activated neutrophil subset in Ncf1 -/- mice featuring a robust interferon signature and high Nlrp3 expression. Transcriptomic analysis confirmed the upregulation of core NLRP3 pathway within these cells. Crucially, treating NOX2-deficient mice with an IL-1 receptor antagonist reduced LN activity scores. Our results showed that NOX2 deficiency was associated with the expansion of a highly inflammatory renal neutrophil subset that may contribute to aggravated renal inflammation. These findings suggest that NOX2 functions as a negative regulator of the NLRP3 inflammasome and IL-1β blockade represents a promising precision therapeutic strategy for patients with LN who exhibit impaired ROS production.

items.title: Comparison of the effects of denosumab and alendronate on fracture risk and bone metabolism in postmenopausal rheumatoid arthritis patients treated with oral glucocorticoids: A propensity score-matched retrospective cohort study.
items.abstract: Postmenopausal rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients receiving oral glucocorticoids (GCs) are at markedly increased risk for osteoporosis and fractures. Direct comparisons between denosumab and alendronate in this high-risk subgroup remain limited. To evaluate denosumab versus alendronate regarding one-year incidence of fragility fractures, bone mineral density (BMD) changes, bone turnover markers, and disease activity in postmenopausal RA patients on long-term oral GCs. Retrospective multi-center propensity score-matched cohort study. From January 2018 to December 2023, 295 patients (122 denosumab, 173 alendronate) were enrolled. Propensity score matching (1:1) balanced 22 baseline covariates, yielding 124 patients (62 per arm). Outcomes included new fragility fractures, BMD alterations (including areal BMD (aBMD)), serum procollagen type I N-terminal propeptide (P1NP) and C-terminal telopeptide of type I collagen (CTx) levels, and disease activity scores over one year. Denosumab produced a significantly greater lumbar spine aBMD gain than alendronate (between-group difference: 0.444%, P=0.025). The absolute risk difference for fragility fracture with denosumab versus alendronate was 3.2% (95% CI: -2.2% to 8.6%), corresponding to fracture rates of 8.1% vs. 1.6% (OR=5.35, 95% CI: 0.59-48.68, P=0.135). Sensitivity analyses suggested a potential trend of elevated risk, but the very low number of fracture events (n=6) precludes definitive conclusions. No significant differences were observed for other BMD sites, bone turnover markers, or disease activity. In postmenopausal RA patients on GCs, denosumab was superior to alendronate for lumbar spine BMD gains. The absolute risk difference for fragility fracture with denosumab versus alendronate was 3.2% (95% CI: -2.2% to 8.6%), but this finding remains inconclusive due to insufficient power and rare events. Larger prospective studies are needed to clarify fracture outcomes. Why was the study done? Postmenopausal women with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) who take steroid medications (glucocorticoids) have a very high risk of developing weak bones (osteoporosis) and fractures. Two common bone-strengthening drugs—denosumab and alendronate—are often used, but no study has directly compared them in this specific group of patients. Researchers wanted to know which drug works better at preventing fractures and improving bone density. What did the researchers do? The team reviewed medical records from 295 postmenopausal women with RA who were taking long-term steroids and received either denosumab or alendronate between 2018 and 2023. They used statistical methods to ensure the two groups were comparable at the start. Over one year, they tracked how many women experienced fractures, changes in bone density, and other health markers. What did the researchers find? Denosumab improved spine bone density slightly more than alendronate. However, fractures occurred more often in the denosumab group (8.1%) compared to the alendronate group (1.6%). While this difference was not definitively statistically significant, some additional analyses suggested a possible increased fracture risk with denosumab. Bone density at other sites and disease activity were similar between the two groups. What do the findings mean? Although denosumab showed better spine bone density results, the concerning trend toward more fractures means these findings should be interpreted very cautiously. Larger studies are needed to determine whether denosumab truly increases fracture risk in this population or if the results were influenced by the limited number of patients or other unmeasured factors.

items.titleZh: 狄诺塞麦与阿仑膦酸钠对接受口服糖皮质激素治疗的绝经后类风湿关节炎患者骨折风险和骨代谢影响的比较：一项倾向评分匹配的回顾性队列研究
items.abstractZh: 接受口服糖皮质激素（GCs）治疗的绝经后类风湿关节炎（RA）患者发生骨质疏松和骨折的风险显著增加。在这一高危亚组中，狄诺塞麦与阿仑膦酸钠的直接比较研究仍然有限。旨在评估狄诺塞麦与阿仑膦酸钠在长期口服糖皮质激素的绝经后RA患者中，一年脆性骨折发生率、骨密度（BMD）变化、骨转换标志物和疾病活动度方面的差异。回顾性多中心倾向评分匹配队列研究。从2018年1月至2023年12月，纳入295例患者（122例狄诺塞麦，173例阿仑膦酸钠）。倾向评分匹配（1:1）平衡了22个基线协变量，最终纳入124例患者（每组62例）。结局包括新发脆性骨折、骨密度变化（包括面积骨密度（aBMD））、血清I型前胶原N端前肽（P1NP）和I型胶原C端交联肽（CTx）水平，以及一年内的疾病活动度评分。狄诺塞麦组腰椎aBMD增幅显著大于阿仑膦酸钠组（组间差异：0.444%，P=0.025）。狄诺塞麦与阿仑膦酸钠相比，脆性骨折的绝对风险差异为3.2%（95% CI：-2.2%至8.6%），对应骨折率分别为8.1%和1.6%（OR=5.35，95% CI：0.59-48.68，P=0.135）。敏感性分析提示可能存在风险升高的趋势，但骨折事件数量极少（n=6）无法得出明确结论。其他部位骨密度、骨转换标志物或疾病活动度均无显著差异。在接受糖皮质激素治疗的绝经后RA患者中，狄诺塞麦在腰椎骨密度增加方面优于阿仑膦酸钠。狄诺塞麦与阿仑膦酸钠相比，脆性骨折的绝对风险差异为3.2%（95% CI：-2.2%至8.6%），但由于检验效能不足和事件罕见，该结果仍不确定。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来阐明骨折结局。为什么进行这项研究？患有类风湿关节炎（RA）并服用类固醇药物（糖皮质激素）的绝经后女性发生骨质疏松和骨折的风险非常高。两种常见的增强骨骼药物——狄诺塞麦和阿仑膦酸钠——经常被使用，但尚无研究在这一特定患者群体中对它们进行直接比较。研究人员想知道哪种药物在预防骨折和改善骨密度方面效果更好。研究人员做了什么？研究团队回顾了2018年至2023年间接受狄诺塞麦或阿仑膦酸钠治疗的295例长期服用类固醇的绝经后RA女性的医疗记录。他们使用统计方法确保两组在开始时具有可比性。在一年内，他们追踪了女性发生骨折的人数、骨密度变化以及其他健康指标。研究人员发现了什么？狄诺塞麦改善脊柱骨密度的程度略高于阿仑膦酸钠。然而，狄诺塞麦组骨折发生率（8.1%）高于阿仑膦酸钠组（1.6%）。虽然这一差异并非明确的统计学显著，但一些额外分析提示狄诺塞麦可能存在骨折风险增加的趋势。其他部位的骨密度和疾病活动度在两组间相似。这些发现意味着什么？尽管狄诺塞麦显示出更好的脊柱骨密度结果，但骨折增多的令人担忧的趋势意味着这些发现应非常谨慎地解读。需要更大规模的研究来确定狄诺塞麦是否确实会增加该人群的骨折风险，或者结果是否受到患者数量有限或其他未测量因素的影响。

items.title: Glucocorticoid discontinuation and clinical phenotypes in patients with giant cell arteritis: A retrospective cohort study from a fast track clinic.
items.abstract: Previous studies have shown that many patients with giant cell arteritis (GCA) remain on glucocorticoid (GC) therapy for several years, though mostly based on older data. Identifying predictors of successful GC tapering is increasingly relevant. to 1) determine the probability of discontinuing GC treatment, 2) characterise clinical phenotypes within the GCA spectrum, and 3) their predictive value for successful GC discontinuation. A retrospective cohort study of all patients diagnosed with GCA in our fast track Clinic (FTC) between September 2018 and December 2021. Clinical, biochemical and imaging data were obtained from patient records from the time of the FTC visit until 31.12.2023. The cumulative incidence of GC discontinuation was estimated using a competing risks model. Symptom- and laboratory-based phenotypes were identified through hierarchical cluster analysis. During the study period, 172 patients were diagnosed with GCA. At baseline, 26% had a prior diagnosis of GCA or polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR). The cumulative incidence of GC discontinuation was 10% at one year, 43% at two years, 58% at three years, and 69% at four and five years after the FTC visit, respectively. Patients with prior GCA/PMR had a lower probability of discontinuing GC treatment than those with new-onset disease. Four symptom-based and three laboratory-based phenotypic clusters were identified, but none of these variables predicted successful GC discontinuation. Multivariable Fine-Gray regression confirmed that previous GCA/PMR was an independent predictor of reduced probability of GC discontinuation. In this real-world cohort, many patients required GC therapy for more than two years. The identified phenotypes did not predict treatment discontinuation. A previous diagnosis of GCA/PMR was associated with a persistent disease course. Why was the study done? Giant cell arteritis (GCA) is an inflammatory disease of blood vessels that requires treatment with glucocorticoids (GC). While these drugs are effective, long-term use can cause serious side effects. Previous studies have suggested that many patients stay on GC treatment for years, but most of this information comes from older data. We wanted to find out how likely patients were to stop GC treatment over time and whether certain disease patterns could predict who would successfully stop treatment. What did the researchers do? We studied 172 patients diagnosed with GCA in a rheumatology department between 2018 and 2021. We collected information from medical records, including symptoms and test results, and followed patients until the end of 2023. We calculated how likely patients were to stop GC treatment over time and looked for patterns in symptoms and lab results that might predict the likelihood of stopping GC treatment. What did the researchers find? The likelihood of stopping GC treatment was 10% after one year, 43% after two years, and almost 70% after four years. Patients who had previously been diagnosed with GCA or polymyalgia rheumatica were less likely to stop treatment than those with new-onset disease. Other factors, such as symptom patterns or blood test results did not predict whether patients could stop GC treatment. What do the findings mean? These patients with GCA were more likely to be able to stop GC treatment than older studies have suggested. However, some patients still need treatment for several years. More research is needed to predict which patients are less likely to stop GC treatment, so that doctors in the future may set more realistic expectations and make more personalised treatment plans.

items.titleZh: 巨细胞动脉炎患者糖皮质激素停药与临床表型：来自快速通道门诊的回顾性队列研究
items.abstractZh: 既往研究表明，许多巨细胞动脉炎（GCA）患者需持续糖皮质激素（GC）治疗数年，但该结论多基于较陈旧的数据。识别成功减停GC的预测因素日益重要。本研究目的为：1）确定停用GC治疗的概率；2）描述GCA谱系内的临床表型；3）评估这些表型对成功停用GC的预测价值。本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入2018年9月至2021年12月在我院快速通道门诊（FTC）诊断的所有GCA患者。从FTC就诊时至2023年12月31日（31.12.2023）的患者病历中获取临床、生化和影像学数据。采用竞争风险模型估计GC停药的累积发生率。通过层次聚类分析识别基于症状和实验室检查的表型。研究期间共172例患者诊断为GCA。基线时，26%的患者既往有GCA或风湿性多肌痛（PMR）诊断。FTC就诊后1年、2年、3年、4年和5年的GC停药累积发生率分别为10%、43%、58%、69%和69%。既往有GCA/PMR的患者停用GC治疗的概率低于新发病患者。共识别出四个基于症状的表型聚类和三个基于实验室检查的表型聚类，但这些变量均不能预测成功停用GC。多因素Fine-Gray回归证实，既往GCA/PMR是GC停药概率降低的独立预测因素。在这个真实世界队列中，许多患者需要GC治疗超过两年。所识别的表型不能预测治疗停药。既往GCA/PMR诊断与持续病程相关。为何进行这项研究？巨细胞动脉炎（GCA）是一种血管炎症性疾病，需要糖皮质激素（GC）治疗。虽然这些药物有效，但长期使用可导致严重副作用。既往研究表明许多患者需维持GC治疗数年，但该信息多来自较陈旧的数据。我们想了解患者随时间推移停用GC治疗的可能性，以及某些疾病模式是否能预测哪些患者能成功停药。研究人员做了什么？我们研究了2018年至2021年间在风湿免疫科诊断为GCA的172例患者。我们从病历中收集了症状和检查结果等信息，并随访患者至2023年底。我们计算了患者随时间停用GC治疗的可能性，并寻找可能预测停药可能性的症状和实验室检查结果模式。研究人员发现了什么？停用GC治疗的可能性在1年后为10%，2年后为43%，4年后接近70%。既往诊断为GCA或风湿性多肌痛的患者停药的可能性低于新发病患者。其他因素，如症状模式或血液检查结果，不能预测患者能否停用GC治疗。这些发现意味着什么？这些GCA患者停用GC治疗的可能性高于既往研究所示。然而，部分患者仍需治疗数年。需要更多研究来预测哪些患者停用GC治疗的可能性较低，以便未来医生能设定更现实的期望并制定更个体化的治疗计划。

items.title: Transcending aging: disease specificity, assessment challenges, and management strategies for rheumatoid arthritis-related sarcopenia.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a systemic autoimmune disorder marked by chronic synovitis, with pathological damages extending beyond joint destruction to skeletal muscle, bone and metabolic homeostasis. Sarcopenia is conventionally regarded as age-driven degeneration, yet its high prevalence in young RA patients indicates a distinct disease-specific muscle phenotype mediated by persistent inflammation and joint disuse. This review establishes an integrated "muscle-bone-fat axis" framework to interpret RA-related myopathy: systemic inflammation and cumulative glucocorticoid exposure synergistically trigger myofibrillar proteolysis, enhance bone resorption and visceral fat accumulation. At the molecular level, catabolic cytokines overactivate the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway; impaired muscle-adipose crosstalk and mitochondrial dysfunction further disrupt muscle fiber integrity. We illustrate the limitations of age-based sarcopenia criteria when applied to RA populations, as active arthritis and pain distort handgrip strength assessment. We further compare muscle-related effects of diverse anti-rheumatic therapies: biological Disease-Modifying Anti-Rheumatic Drugs (bDMARDs) reverse systemic catabolism to preserve muscle mass, while JAK inhibitors exhibit superior efficacy in recovering physical performance and muscle strength. Collectively, we propose a paradigm shift from joint-centered symptomatic care to a multidisciplinary treat-to-target strategy. Early pharmacological remission combined with pain-adjusted progressive resistance training and individualized nutritional support is recommended to sustain long-term physical function in RA patients.

items.title: Real-world therapeutic strategies in active adult-onset Still's disease: clinical insights from the GIRRCS-AOSD study group.
items.abstract: To evaluate the therapeutic management of patients with active adult-onset Still's disease (AOSD) in a multicentre real-world setting and to provide and compare current real-world treatment strategies with existing recent international recommendations. From January 2022 to December 2023, 173 consecutive patients with active AOSD attending centres participating in the Gruppo Italiano di Ricerca in Reumatologia Clinica e Sperimentale (GIRRCS) AOSD research study group were prospectively enrolled. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were collected, and therapeutic strategies prescribed by the treating physicians were systematically recorded. Factors associated with the administration of biologic disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (bDMARDs), including IL-1 and IL-6 inhibitors, were analysed. Glucocorticoids were administered in 97.7% of patients. Conventional synthetic DMARDs were prescribed in 58.8% of cases, mainly methotrexate and cyclosporin A. Overall, 43.3% of patients received bDMARDs, predominantly IL-1 and IL-6 inhibitors. Specifically, 33.5% were treated with IL-1 inhibitors, 5.8% with IL-6 inhibitors, and 4.0% with tumour necrosis factor inhibitors. After three months of treatment, 86.7% of patients achieved clinical inactive disease as assessed by the treating physician. Comparing recorded treatment strategies with international recommendations, no compliance was found regarding the use of glucocorticoids, which are recommended to be markedly limited or avoided, and early administration of bDMARDs, which were administered within 3 months in a minority of patients. This multicentre real-world study outlines current therapeutic approaches for patients with active AOSD and highlights a gap between international treatment recommendations and clinical practice, underscoring the need for further studies to optimize patient management.

items.titleZh: 活动性成人斯蒂尔病的真实世界治疗策略：来自GIRRCS-AOSD研究组的临床见解
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估多中心真实世界环境中活动性成人斯蒂尔病（AOSD）患者的治疗管理，并提供和比较当前真实世界治疗策略与近期国际推荐意见。从2022年1月至2023年12月，前瞻性纳入了173例连续就诊于意大利临床与实验风湿病学研究组（GIRRCS）AOSD研究组参与中心的活动性AOSD患者。收集人口统计学、临床和实验室数据，并系统记录治疗医师开具的治疗策略。分析了与生物制剂改善病情抗风湿药（bDMARDs）使用相关的因素，包括IL-1和IL-6抑制剂。97.7%的患者接受了糖皮质激素治疗。58.8%的病例处方了传统合成DMARDs，主要是甲氨蝶呤和环孢素A。总体而言，43.3%的患者接受了bDMARDs，主要为IL-1和IL-6抑制剂。具体而言，33.5%接受IL-1抑制剂治疗，5.8%接受IL-6抑制剂治疗，4.0%接受肿瘤坏死因子抑制剂治疗。治疗3个月后，86.7%的患者经治疗医师评估达到临床非活动性疾病。将记录的治疗策略与国际推荐意见进行比较，发现糖皮质激素的使用不符合推荐（推荐显著限制或避免使用），且bDMARDs的早期给药不符合推荐（少数患者在3个月内接受治疗）。这项多中心真实世界研究概述了活动性AOSD患者当前的治疗方法，并强调了国际治疗推荐与临床实践之间的差距，提示需要进一步研究以优化患者管理。

items.title: Serum IL-32γ as a biomarker for remission assessment in systemic lupus erythematosus.
items.abstract: To investigate the potential of serum interleukin (IL)-32γ levels as a biomarker for assessing lupus low disease activity state (LLDAS) and remission, the targets of a treat-to-target strategy, in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). We analyzed sera from 40 patients with SLE. Serum IL-32γ levels were measured using an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, alongside conventional serologic markers (C3, C4, anti-double-stranded DNA antibody). Disease status was classified according to LLDAS, definition of remission in SLE (DORIS) remission, and glucocorticoid (GC)-free remission. Correlations with SLE disease activity index 2000 (SLEDAI-2K) were examined using Spearman's rank correlation coefficient, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analyses were performed to evaluate discriminative accuracy for disease state. Serum IL-32γ levels correlated significantly with SLEDAI-2K (rho=0.401, p=0.010), as did the conventional serologic markers. In ROC analyses, IL-32γ was statistically significant in discriminating LLDAS (area under the curve [AUC]=0.728, p=0.014), similar to the other conventional serologic markers. However, for more stringent definitions, IL-32γ was the only serologic marker that retained statistical significance (DORIS remission: AUC = 0.785, p=0.014; and GC-free remission: AUC = 0.831, p=0.007). Serum IL-32γ is significantly associated with overall disease activity and shows promising discriminatory ability for disease states in SLE. Notably, it retains discriminative capacity in stringent remission definitions, underscoring its potential as a novel biomarker. These findings suggest that IL-32γ could complement existing tools in treat-to-target strategies, offering a simple serologic marker to guide therapy toward the ultimate goal of GC-free remission.

items.titleZh: 血清IL-32γ作为系统性红斑狼疮缓解评估的生物标志物
items.abstractZh: 探讨血清白细胞介素(IL)-32γ水平作为评估系统性红斑狼疮(SLE)患者狼疮低疾病活动状态(LLDAS)和缓解（达标治疗策略的目标）的生物标志物的潜力。我们分析了40例SLE患者的血清。使用酶联免疫吸附测定法测量血清IL-32γ水平，同时检测常规血清学标志物(C3、C4、抗双链DNA抗体)。根据LLDAS、SLE缓解定义(DORIS)缓解和无糖皮质激素(GC-)缓解对疾病状态进行分类。使用Spearman秩相关系数检查与SLE疾病活动指数2000(SLEDAI-2K)的相关性，并进行受试者工作特征(ROC)曲线分析以评估对疾病状态的判别准确性。血清IL-32γ水平与SLEDAI-2K显著相关(rho=0.401，p=0.010)，常规血清学标志物也是如此。在ROC分析中，IL-32γ在区分LLDAS方面具有统计学显著性(曲线下面积[AUC]=0.728，p=0.014)，与其他常规血清学标志物相似。然而，对于更严格的定义，IL-32γ是唯一保持统计学显著性的血清学标志物(DORIS缓解：AUC=0.785，p=0.014；无GC-缓解：AUC=0.831，p=0.007)。血清IL-32γ与总体疾病活动显著相关，并对SLE的疾病状态显示出有前景的判别能力。值得注意的是，它在严格的缓解定义中保持判别能力，强调了其作为新型生物标志物的潜力。这些发现表明，IL-32γ可以补充达标治疗策略中的现有工具，提供一种简单的血清学标志物来指导治疗，以实现无GC-缓解的最终目标。

items.title: Impact of social deprivation on cancer occurrence and cardiovascular events in systemic sclerosis.
items.abstract: Cardiovascular events (CVEs) and malignancy are important non-disease-related causes of mortality in SSc. We evaluated secondary care utilisation and impact of deprivation on comorbidity patterns in SSc in England. We analysed secondary care service utilisation in SSc using Hospital Episode Statistics for England for 2024. Cases were linked to Index of Multiple Deprivation deciles. Myocardial infarction (MI), lung cancer, breast cancer, melanoma rates and short-term all-cause mortality were explored, alongside comparisons with SLE and RA. In 2024, ≈6000 people with SSc (84.6% female, 70.8% between 51 and 80 years of age, 73.3% White ethnicity) accessed secondary healthcare in England. Older SSc patients were overrepresented in less-deprived postcodes ( P  < 0.001). MI, lung cancer, breast cancer and melanoma were more common in SSc compared with unmatched estimates in the general population. Lung cancer was more frequent among less-deprived patients ( P  < 0.001). The all-cause mortality attrition rate was ≈3% in SSc over 3 months (30.8% with lung cancer and >60% with melanoma). Rates of breast cancer were higher in SSc compared with SLE ( P  = 0.014) and RA ( P  = 0.012). There was a higher rate of lung cancer in SSc compared with SLE ( P  < 0.001). Melanoma rates were similar across diseases (≈0.2%). Secondary care utilisation in SSc suggests less deprived SSc patients are older. All-cause mortality is higher in SSc patients receiving cancer care. Cancer occurrence is higher in SSc compared with SLE and RA. Our findings might support healthcare services planning and cancer screening for SSc in England.

items.titleZh: 社会剥夺对系统性硬化症癌症发生和心血管事件的影响
items.abstractZh: 心血管事件（CVEs）和恶性肿瘤是系统性硬化症（SSc）中重要的非疾病相关死亡原因。我们评估了英格兰SSc患者二级医疗服务的利用情况以及剥夺对合并症模式的影响。我们使用2024年英格兰医院统计数据分析SSc的二级医疗服务利用情况。病例与多重剥夺指数十分位数相关联。探讨了心肌梗死（MI）、肺癌、乳腺癌、黑色素瘤的发生率及短期全因死亡率，并与系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）和类风湿关节炎（RA）进行了比较。2024年，英格兰约有6000名SSc患者（84.6%为女性，70.8%年龄在51至80岁之间，73.3%为白人）使用了二级医疗服务。年龄较大的SSc患者在剥夺程度较低的地区占比过高（P < 0.001）。与未匹配的一般人群估计值相比，SSc患者中MI、肺癌、乳腺癌和黑色素瘤更为常见。肺癌在剥夺程度较低的患者中更为常见（P < 0.001）。SSc患者3个月内的全因死亡率约为3%（肺癌患者为30.8%，黑色素瘤患者>60%）。SSc患者的乳腺癌发生率高于SLE（P = 0.014）和RA（P = 0.012）。SSc患者的肺癌发生率高于SLE（P < 0.001）。黑色素瘤发生率在各疾病间相似（约0.2%）。SSc的二级医疗服务利用情况表明，剥夺程度较低的SSc患者年龄较大。接受癌症治疗的SSc患者全因死亡率较高。SSc的癌症发生率高于SLE和RA。我们的发现可能支持英格兰SSc的医疗服务规划和癌症筛查。

items.title: Cotton wool spots as the only fundoscopic manifestation of giant cell arteritis: A scoping review.
items.abstract: This study aimed to review and describe isolated cotton wool spots (CWS) on retinal examination in patients with systemic or occult presentation of giant cell arteritis (GCA). In this scoping review, following the PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) Extension for Scoping Reviews, PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science were searched for peer-reviewed articles reporting an association between GCA and CWS from 1960 to 13 th of June 2026. Case reports and case series of confirmed GCA with CWS as the sole fundoscopic finding were included. Data were charted independently by two reviewers using a standardized Excel extraction form. Sixteen articles, including fifteen case reports and one case series, were included in the study. 76.19% of patients had concurrent systemic symptoms, while the remaining 23.81% had an occult presentation. Patients with occult GCA tended to be younger at presentation compared with those with systemic disease. No difference in inflammatory markers was observed between the occult and the systemic presentation of the disease. This review summarizes the current evidence and characteristics of CWS as an isolated retinal manifestation of GCA. The included evidence suggests that this atypical presentation may occur even in the absence of systemic symptoms, highlighting the importance of early clinical recognition, as delayed diagnosis may lead to irreversible visual loss. Acest studiu a avut ca scop revizuirea și descrierea exudatelor moi retiniene (CWS) ca manifestare izolată retinianǎ la pacienții cu prezentare sistemicǎ sau ocultǎ a arteritei cu celule gigante (GCA). În cadrul acestui scoping-review, realizat conform extensiei PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) pentru scoping reviews, au fost interogate bazele de date: PubMed, Scopus şi Web of Science pentru articole supuse evaluǎrii de cǎtre experți, care raporteaza o asociere intre arterita cu celule gigante (temporal arteritis/boala Horton) şi exudatele moi retiniene (cotton wool spots) în perioada 1960 – 13 iunie 2026. Au fost incluse rapoarte și serii de cazuri cu diagnosticul confirmat de arterită cu celule gigante, în care exudatele moi au reprezentat singura manifestare fundoscopică. Datele au fost extrase independent de doi evaluatori, utilizand un formular standardizat de colectare a datelor in Miscrosoft Excel. Au fost incluse 16 articole, dintre care 15 cazuri clinice şi o serie de cazuri. 76.19% dintre pacienți au prezentat simptome sistemice concomitente, în timp ce 23.81% au avut o prezentare ocultǎ. În sursele incluse, pacientii cu formǎ ocultǎ de GCA au avut tendița de a fi mai tineri la momentul prezentǎrii comparativ cu cei cu manifestǎri sistemice. De asemenea, nu s-au evidențiat diferențe ale markerilor inflamatori între prezentarea ocultă și cea sistemică a bolii. Acest review sintetizează dovezile disponibile și caracteristicile CWS ca manifestare oculară retiniană izolată a GCA. Datele incluse sugereazǎ cǎ aceastǎ prezentare atipicǎ poate aparea şi in absența simptomelor sistemice, subliniind importanța recunoaşterii clinic precoce, întrucât întarzierea diagnosticului poate conduce la pierderea vizualǎ ireversibilǎ.

items.titleZh: 棉絮斑作为巨细胞动脉炎唯一眼底表现：范围综述。
items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在回顾并描述巨细胞动脉炎（GCA）患者视网膜检查中孤立性棉絮斑（CWS）的表现，包括系统性或隐匿性起病。本范围综述遵循PRISMA（系统综述和荟萃分析首选报告项目）范围综述扩展版，检索了PubMed、Scopus和Web of Science中1960年至2026年6月13日期间报告GCA与CWS关联的同行评审文章。纳入经确诊的GCA且CWS为唯一眼底发现的病例报告和病例系列。两名评审员使用标准化Excel提取表独立提取数据。研究共纳入16篇文章，包括15篇病例报告和1个病例系列。76.19%的患者伴有全身症状，其余23.81%为隐匿性起病。隐匿性GCA患者起病时年龄往往较系统性起病者年轻。隐匿性与系统性起病之间的炎症标志物未见差异。本综述总结了CWS作为GCA孤立性视网膜表现的现有证据和特征。纳入的证据表明，即使没有全身症状，也可能出现这种非典型表现，强调了早期临床识别的重要性，因为诊断延迟可能导致不可逆的视力丧失。

items.title: Small Bowel Perforation as an Initial Manifestation of Immune Deficiency and Dysregulation-Associated Lymphoma in a Patient With Rheumatoid Arthritis: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Lymphoid proliferation and lymphomas associated with immune deficiency and dysregulation (IDD-LPD and lymphomas) are rare entities that occur in patients with autoimmune diseases, such as rheumatoid arthritis (RA) on immunosuppressant medications. Herein, we report a case of a 66-year-old woman diagnosed with IDD lymphoma after emergency laparotomy for ileal perforation. She had a history of RA, had been treated with antirheumatic drugs for 15 years, and was recently suspected of having gastric cancer with multiple liver metastases by her primary care physician. The patient was referred to our hospital because of severe abdominal pain. Computed tomography (CT) revealed peritonitis with intra-abdominal free air, and emergency laparotomy was performed. Intraoperative findings revealed multiple nodules in the ileum with two perforations, in addition to a gastric tumor and multiple liver tumors. Partial resection of the perforated ileum and anastomosis were performed. Histopathological examination of the resected ileum confirmed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, leading to a diagnosis of IDD-lymphoma. Antirheumatic drugs were discontinued after diagnosis. Although the liver lesions shrank after discontinuation, Gallium-67 scintigraphy showed diffuse liver uptake. After careful discussion with hematologists, chemotherapy was administered (rituximab plus cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, and prednisone, six cycles). One year after chemotherapy, the patient remained in remission, and her RA symptoms were stable without antirheumatic drugs.

items.titleZh: 小肠穿孔作为类风湿关节炎患者免疫缺陷和失调相关淋巴瘤的首发表现：一例病例报告
items.abstractZh: 与免疫缺陷和失调相关的淋巴增殖和淋巴瘤（IDD-LPD和淋巴瘤）是罕见的实体，发生在患有自身免疫性疾病（如类风湿关节炎（RA））并接受免疫抑制药物治疗的患者中。在此，我们报告一例66岁女性患者，因回肠穿孔接受急诊剖腹手术后被诊断为IDD淋巴瘤。她有RA病史，接受抗风湿药物治疗15年，近期被其初级保健医生怀疑患有胃癌伴多发肝转移。患者因严重腹痛转诊至我院。计算机断层扫描（CT）显示腹膜炎伴腹腔内游离气体，遂行急诊剖腹手术。术中发现回肠多发结节伴两处穿孔，此外还有胃肿瘤和多发肝肿瘤。行穿孔回肠部分切除及吻合术。切除回肠的组织病理学检查证实为弥漫性大B细胞淋巴瘤，从而诊断为IDD淋巴瘤。诊断后停用抗风湿药物。尽管停药后肝病灶缩小，但镓-67闪烁扫描显示肝脏弥漫性摄取。经与血液科医生仔细讨论后，给予化疗（利妥昔单抗加环磷酰胺、多柔比星、长春新碱和泼尼松，共6个周期）。化疗一年后，患者仍处于缓解状态，且未使用抗风湿药物的情况下RA症状稳定。

items.title: TRAF3IP2 (rs13190932) polymorphism in psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis: susceptibility, systemic inflammation and response to methotrexate.
items.abstract: Psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis (PsA) are chronic immune-mediated inflammatory disorders. The TRAF3IP2 gene encodes Act1, a crucial adaptor protein in interleukin-17 signalling, which is fundamental to the pathophysiology of psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis. To examine the correlation between the TRAF3IP2 (rs13190932) polymorphism and the susceptibility to psoriasis and PsA. This prospective observational cohort study enrolled 120 patients with psoriasis, comprising 40 with PsA, alongside 40 age- and sex-matched healthy controls. The Psoriasis Area and Severity Index (PASI) and the Disease Activity Index for Psoriatic Arthritis (DAPSA) were used. Real-time polymerase chain reaction was used to genotype TRAF3IP2 (rs13190932). We used non-parametric statistical analyses. Patients with psoriasis showed markedly elevated inflammatory markers and metabolic irregularities in comparison to controls. The AA genotype and A allele of TRAF3IP2 (rs13190932) were substantially more prevalent in patients with psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis, indicating heightened disease vulnerability. There was a positive correlation between disease severity and systemic inflammatory markers. After 12 weeks of treatment with methotrexate, the PASI and DAPSA scores significantly decreased. There was no notable correlation between TRAF3IP2 genotypes and illness severity or therapy response. The TRAF3IP2 (rs13190932) polymorphism is substantially linked to susceptibility to psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis, but not to disease severity or short-term response to methotrexate. Methotrexate continues to be an effective short-term systemic treatment for both diseases.

items.titleZh: TRAF3IP2（rs13190932）多态性在银屑病和银屑病关节炎中的作用：易感性、全身性炎症及对甲氨蝶呤的反应。
items.abstractZh: 银屑病和银屑病关节炎（PsA）是慢性免疫介导的炎症性疾病。TRAF3IP2基因编码Act1，这是白细胞介素-17信号传导中的一个关键衔接蛋白，对银屑病和银屑病关节炎的病理生理学至关重要。本研究旨在探讨TRAF3IP2（rs13190932）多态性与银屑病和银屑病关节炎易感性之间的相关性。这项前瞻性观察性队列研究纳入了120名银屑病患者，其中40名患有银屑病关节炎，以及40名年龄和性别匹配的健康对照。使用了银屑病面积和严重程度指数（PASI）和银屑病关节炎疾病活动指数（DAPSA）。采用实时聚合酶链反应对TRAF3IP2（rs13190932）进行基因分型。我们使用了非参数统计分析。与对照组相比，银屑病患者的炎症标志物显著升高，并存在代谢异常。TRAF3IP2（rs13190932）的AA基因型和A等位基因在银屑病和银屑病关节炎患者中显著更常见，表明疾病易感性增加。疾病严重程度与全身性炎症标志物之间存在正相关。甲氨蝶呤治疗12周后，PASI和DAPSA评分显著降低。TRAF3IP2基因型与疾病严重程度或治疗反应之间没有显著相关性。TRAF3IP2（rs13190932）多态性与银屑病和银屑病关节炎的易感性显著相关，但与疾病严重程度或对甲氨蝶呤的短期反应无关。甲氨蝶呤仍然是这两种疾病有效的短期全身性治疗。

items.title: Hemoglobin-Red Blood Cell Distribution Width Ratio (HRR) and Rheumatoid Arthritis Risk: A Population-Based Study from the NHANES.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a prevalent autoimmune disease with a substantial health burden. The Hemoglobin-red cell distribution width ratio (HRR) is a novel inflammation-related biomarker, yet its association with RA risk remains unexplored. This study aimed to investigate whether HRR is independently associated with RA risk, given the lack of prior evidence on this relationship. This population-based study included 34,483 adults from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey database, comprising 2403 RA patients. Weighted logistic regression models and restricted cubic spline analyses were employed to examine the relationship between HRR and RA risk, adjusting for demographic and clinical covariates. HRR levels were significantly lower in RA patients compared to non-RA individuals. A significant inverse, approximately linear association was observed between HRR and RA risk. Subgroup analyses showed that this relationship was modified by gender, education level, smoking and drinking status (all P for interaction <0.05). Lower HRR is independently associated with increased RA risk. These findings highlight HRR as a potential protective factor and provide new insights for RA risk stratification in clinical practice.

items.titleZh: 血红蛋白-红细胞分布宽度比值（HRR）与类风湿关节炎风险：一项基于NHANES的人群研究。
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种常见的自身免疫性疾病，具有沉重的健康负担。血红蛋白-红细胞分布宽度比值（HRR）是一种新型的炎症相关生物标志物，但其与RA风险的关系尚未被探索。本研究旨在调查HRR是否与RA风险独立相关，鉴于此前缺乏关于这一关系的证据。这项基于人群的研究纳入了来自国家健康与营养调查数据库的34,483名成年人，其中包括2,403名RA患者。采用加权逻辑回归模型和限制性立方样条分析来检验HRR与RA风险之间的关系，并调整了人口统计学和临床协变量。RA患者的HRR水平显著低于非RA个体。观察到HRR与RA风险之间存在显著的、近似线性的负相关。亚组分析显示，这种关系受性别、教育水平、吸烟和饮酒状况的影响（所有交互作用P值均<0.05）。较低的HRR与RA风险增加独立相关。这些发现凸显了HRR作为潜在保护因素的作用，并为临床实践中RA风险分层提供了新的见解。

items.title: Assessing the preclinical progress in the therapeutic targeting of axial spondyloarthritis.
items.abstract: Axial spondyloarthritis (SpA) is a chronic inflammatory rheumatism affecting predominantly the axial skeleton and frequently also the peripheral joints, often associated with specific extra-musculoskeletal manifestations. This complex disease is still poorly understood resulting in a lack of cure. While symptomatic treatments are available, preclinical models/analyses are needed to identify new therapeutic targets in order to improve axial SpA treatment. We discussed strengths and weaknesses of preclinical models used to identify and validate emerging therapeutic targets. Progress in developing new therapies for axial SpA remains slow due to its biological complexity and limited understanding of early disease mechanisms. Current treatments mainly target downstream inflammation, contributing to persistent unmet needs and variable responses. Future progress will rely on more pathophysiologically relevant models, interdisciplinary approaches, and integration of insights from related diseases to accelerate personalized therapeutic development.

items.titleZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎治疗靶向的临床前研究进展评估
items.abstractZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎（SpA）是一种慢性炎症性风湿病，主要影响中轴骨骼，也常累及外周关节，并常伴有特定的肌肉骨骼外表现。这种复杂疾病仍未被充分理解，导致缺乏治愈方法。尽管已有对症治疗，但仍需要临床前模型/分析来识别新的治疗靶点，以改善中轴型SpA的治疗。我们讨论了用于识别和验证新兴治疗靶点的临床前模型的优缺点。由于中轴型SpA的生物学复杂性以及对早期疾病机制的理解有限，开发新疗法的进展仍然缓慢。目前的治疗主要针对下游炎症，导致持续未满足的需求和不同的治疗反应。未来的进展将依赖于更具病理生理相关性的模型、跨学科方法以及整合相关疾病的见解，以加速个性化治疗的开发。

items.title: Longitudinal Evaluation of Serum Varicella-zoster Virus Viral Load in a Woman with Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Complicated by a Visceral Disseminated Varicella-zoster Virus Infection: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Visceral disseminated varicella-zoster virus infection (VD-VZV) is a rare but life-threatening condition, and treatment-response monitoring has not yet been established. We report a case of a 47-year-old woman with systemic lupus erythematosus who developed primary varicella complicated by VD-VZV during prednisolone and mycophenolate mofetil therapy. She presented with a generalized vesicular rash, dyspnea, severe epigastric pain, pneumonia, and acute hepatitis with negative VZV IgM/IgG. Intravenous acyclovir was initiated and escalated, resulting in a clinical improvement. Serum VZV DNA quantified by droplet digital PCR peaked on day 4 (3.1×10 6 copies/mL) and declined with recovery, suggesting that serial serum VZV DNA monitoring may be useful for assessing the disease activity and treatment response in such patients.

items.titleZh: 血清水痘-带状疱疹病毒载量在系统性红斑狼疮女性患者并发内脏播散性水痘-带状疱疹病毒感染中的纵向评估：病例报告
items.abstractZh: 内脏播散性水痘-带状疱疹病毒感染（VD-VZV）是一种罕见但危及生命的疾病，其治疗反应监测尚未建立。我们报告一例47岁女性系统性红斑狼疮患者，在泼尼松龙和吗替麦考酚酯治疗期间发生原发性水痘并并发VD-VZV。患者表现为全身性水疱性皮疹、呼吸困难、严重上腹痛、肺炎和急性肝炎，VZV IgM/IgG阴性。静脉注射阿昔洛韦启动并升级治疗后，临床症状改善。通过微滴式数字PCR定量检测血清VZV DNA，在第4天达到峰值（3.1×10^6拷贝/mL），并随病情恢复而下降，提示连续监测血清VZV DNA可能有助于评估此类患者的疾病活动度和治疗反应。

items.title: Prevalence and clinical relevance of anti-drug antibodies in psoriatic arthritis: a systematic review.
items.abstract: To determine the prevalence of anti-drug antibodies (ADAs) in patients with psoriatic arthritis (PsA) treated with biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs (bDMARDs) and to evaluate associations with serum drug levels, clinical efficacy and safety. A Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses-guided systematic review was conducted. MEDLINE, Embase and Cochrane CENTRAL were searched from inception to September 2025. Randomised controlled trials and observational studies reporting ADA measurement in adults with PsA receiving bDMARDs were included. The risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias Tool 2 and the Risk of Bias in Non-randomised Studies of Interventions. 28 studies (19 randomised controlled trials and 9 observational studies) were included. ADA prevalence varied widely between bDMARDs and across studies of the same drug and was not directly comparable due to immunoassay heterogeneity. The highest ADA prevalence was observed with adalimumab, infliximab and golimumab followed by ustekinumab, ixekizumab, certolizumab pegol and guselkumab, while secukinumab and etanercept demonstrated very low or absent immunogenicity. Across tumour necrosis factor (TNF) inhibitor studies, ADAs were consistently associated with lower serum drug levels and reduced clinical response, while concomitant methotrexate was associated with lower ADA prevalence. In contrast, serum drug level and clinical outcome data for interleukin (IL)-17, IL-12/23 and IL-23 inhibitors were limited or lacking. Immunogenicity-related adverse events were uncommon, and evidence was insufficient to establish an association with ADAs across bDMARDs. ADA prevalence in PsA varies widely between bDMARDs and across studies of the same bDMARD. ADAs appear most clinically relevant for TNF inhibitors, whereas evidence for other biological classes remains limited. Immunoassay heterogeneity limits comparability, highlighting the need for standardised prospective studies. CRD420251121662.

items.titleZh: 银屑病关节炎中抗药物抗体的患病率及临床相关性：一项系统综述
items.abstractZh: 旨在确定接受生物疾病改善抗风湿药（bDMARDs）治疗的银屑病关节炎（PsA）患者中抗药物抗体（ADAs）的患病率，并评估其与血清药物水平、临床疗效和安全性的关联。按照系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目指南进行了一项系统综述。检索了MEDLINE、Embase和Cochrane CENTRAL数据库，时间从建库至2025年9月。纳入报告接受bDMARDs治疗的成人PsA患者ADA测量的随机对照试验和观察性研究。使用Cochrane偏倚风险工具2和非随机干预研究偏倚风险评估工具评估偏倚风险。共纳入28项研究（19项随机对照试验和9项观察性研究）。ADA患病率在不同bDMARDs之间以及同一药物的不同研究之间差异很大，且由于免疫测定方法的异质性，无法直接比较。ADA患病率最高见于阿达木单抗、英夫利西单抗和戈利木单抗，其次是乌司奴单抗、依奇珠单抗、培塞利珠单抗和古塞奇尤单抗，而苏金单抗和依那西普表现出极低或无免疫原性。在肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）抑制剂研究中，ADAs始终与较低的血清药物水平和降低的临床应答相关，而联合使用甲氨蝶呤与较低的ADA患病率相关。相比之下，白细胞介素（IL）-17、IL-12/23和IL-23抑制剂的血清药物水平和临床结局数据有限或缺乏。免疫原性相关不良事件不常见，且证据不足以确定ADAs与各bDMARDs之间的关联。PsA中ADA患病率在不同bDMARDs之间以及同一bDMARD的不同研究之间差异很大。ADAs似乎对TNF抑制剂最具临床相关性，而其他生物类别的证据仍然有限。免疫测定方法的异质性限制了可比性，凸显了标准化前瞻性研究的必要性。CRD420251121662。

items.title: Integration of synovial pathotypes and serum proteomic modules as determinants of disease progression and therapeutic response in early rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is characterised by marked clinical, histological and molecular heterogeneity, complicating treatment-response prediction. This study evaluated associations between synovial pathotypes, pathotype-associated serum proteomic patterns and 6-month clinical outcomes in early RA. A total of 147 patients with early RA were included in two independent cohorts. In cohort 1, 25 patients underwent synovial biopsy for histological classification by synovial pathotype and Krenn synovitis score. Serum samples collected at biopsy were analysed using the Olink Inflammation panel. Cohort 2, comprising 122 patients, was used to assess the directional consistency of associations between predefined serum proteomic scores and 6-month European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology (EULAR) response. The lymphomyeloid pathotype was associated with higher disease activity, autoantibody positivity and increased synovial immune infiltration. High Krenn score was also associated with greater inflammatory burden and higher disease activity. However, no significant differences in treatment response were observed according to Krenn score, whereas synovial pathotype was associated with differences in biological or targeted synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drug (b/tsDMARD) initiation and exploratory 6-month response patterns. Pathotype-associated serum protein patterns identified in cohort 1 showed differential distributions across histological groups. Higher lymphomyeloid scores were observed among conventional synthetic disease-modifying antirheumatic drug responders, whereas higher diffuse-myeloid scores were observed among b/tsDMARD non-responders. These treatment-stratified associations were exploratory and directionally consistent after adjustment in cohort 2, although neither reached statistical significance. Synovial pathotypes in early RA were associated with distinct circulating proteomic patterns reflecting tissue-level heterogeneity. This tissue-to-blood approach supports development of pathotype-associated serum profiles as candidate minimally invasive biomarkers and provides a promising framework for precision medicine in RA.

items.titleZh: 滑膜病理类型与血清蛋白质组模块的整合作为早期类风湿关节炎疾病进展和治疗反应的决定因素。
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）以显著的临床、组织学和分子异质性为特征，使治疗反应预测复杂化。本研究评估了早期RA中滑膜病理类型、与病理类型相关的血清蛋白质组模式与6个月临床结局之间的关联。共纳入两个独立队列中的147例早期RA患者。在队列1中，25例患者接受了滑膜活检，用于通过滑膜病理类型和Krenn滑膜炎评分进行组织学分类。活检时收集的血清样本使用Olink炎症panel进行分析。队列2包含122例患者，用于评估预设血清蛋白质组评分与6个月欧洲风湿病学协会联盟（EULAR）反应之间关联的方向一致性。淋巴髓系病理类型与较高的疾病活动度、自身抗体阳性和滑膜免疫浸润增加相关。高Krenn评分也与更大的炎症负担和更高的疾病活动度相关。然而，根据Krenn评分未观察到治疗反应的显著差异，而滑膜病理类型与生物或靶向合成疾病修饰抗风湿药（b/tsDMARD）启动和探索性6个月反应模式的差异相关。在队列1中识别的与病理类型相关的血清蛋白模式在不同组织学组间显示出差异分布。在传统合成疾病修饰抗风湿药应答者中观察到较高的淋巴髓系评分，而在b/tsDMARD无应答者中观察到较高的弥漫髓系评分。这些按治疗分层的关联是探索性的，在队列2中调整后方向一致，但均未达到统计学显著性。早期RA中的滑膜病理类型与反映组织水平异质性的不同循环蛋白质组模式相关。这种组织到血液的方法支持开发与病理类型相关的血清谱作为候选微创生物标志物，并为RA的精准医学提供了有前景的框架。

items.title: Biomarker-guided stratification of pulmonary vulnerability in juvenile dermatomyositis-associated interstitial lung disease.
items.abstract: Interstitial lung disease (ILD), an uncommon but severe complication of juvenile dermatomyositis (JDM), contributes disproportionately to morbidity and mortality despite its insidious and initially asymptomatic presentation. Clinical practice focuses on the detection of established lung damage, however it is vital to identify at-risk patients and provide deeper mechanistic understanding towards proactive care and clinical vigilance. Emerging evidence suggests that JDM-associated ILD represents an interferon (IFN)-driven immunobiological endotype, shaped by myositis-specific autoantibodies and distinct cytokine profiles. Within this framework, biomarkers operate across interconnected layers, from autoantibody-defined risk to pathway activation and tissue injury. While autoantibody profiling is clinically actionable, cytokine and IFN-related biomarkers remain investigational. Integrating these insights may enable earlier risk stratification, tailored monitoring, and targeted therapies.
