items.title: Cardiovascular and Thromboembolic Risk With Upadacitinib in Spondyloarthritis and Inflammatory Bowel Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
items.abstract: Immune-mediated inflammatory diseases (IMIDs), including axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA), psoriatic arthritis (PsA), Crohn's disease (CD), and ulcerative colitis (UC), share overlapping inflammatory pathways and frequently coexist, supporting the relevance of evaluating treatment safety across these conditions. Upadacitinib, a selective Janus kinase 1 inhibitor, is approved for multiple IMIDs; however, concerns regarding major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) and venous thromboembolism (VTE) have emerged based on class-related safety signals. We conducted systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials to assess the risk of MACE and VTE associated with upadacitinib compared with placebo or active comparators in patients with spondyloarthritis (SpA) and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). A systematic search of PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library, and ClinicalTrials.gov identified eligible trials. Risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were pooled using a random-effects model. Eight RCTs comprising 4,433 patients were included, of whom 2,868 received upadacitinib. Across studies, MACE and VTE events were rare in both treatment and control groups. Upadacitinib was not associated with an increased risk of MACE (RR 0.35; 95% CI 0.05-2.19; p = 0.259) or VTE (RR 0.31; 95% CI 0.04-2.55; p = 0.279) in patients with SpA and IBD, with no observed heterogeneity (I2 = 0%). However, the low number of events resulted in wide confidence intervals and limited precision, precluding definitive conclusions regarding cardiovascular and thromboembolic safety. Larger randomized controlled trials and long-term real-world studies are needed to further evaluate these outcomes.

items.titleZh: 乌帕替尼在脊柱关节炎和炎症性肠病中的心血管及血栓栓塞风险：随机对照试验的荟萃分析
items.abstractZh: 免疫介导的炎症性疾病（IMIDs），包括中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）、银屑病关节炎（PsA）、克罗恩病（CD）和溃疡性结肠炎（UC），共享重叠的炎症通路且常共存，支持评估这些疾病治疗安全性的相关性。乌帕替尼，一种选择性Janus激酶1抑制剂，已被批准用于多种IMIDs；然而，基于同类药物的安全性信号，对其主要不良心血管事件（MACE）和静脉血栓栓塞（VTE）的担忧已经出现。我们进行了随机对照试验的系统评价和荟萃分析，以评估乌帕替尼与安慰剂或活性对照相比，在脊柱关节炎（SpA）和炎症性肠病（IBD）患者中MACE和VTE的风险。对PubMed、Embase、Cochrane Library和ClinicalTrials.gov的系统检索确定了符合条件的试验。使用随机效应模型汇总风险比（RR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。共纳入8项随机对照试验，涉及4,433名患者，其中2,868名接受乌帕替尼。在各研究中，治疗组和对照组的MACE和VTE事件均罕见。乌帕替尼在SpA和IBD患者中与MACE（RR 0.35；95% CI 0.05-2.19；p = 0.259）或VTE（RR 0.31；95% CI 0.04-2.55；p = 0.279）风险增加无关，且未观察到异质性（I2 = 0%）。然而，事件数量少导致置信区间宽且精确度有限，无法就心血管和血栓栓塞安全性得出明确结论。需要更大规模的随机对照试验和长期真实世界研究来进一步评估这些结局。

items.title: A population-scale transcriptional atlas of blood and tissue in lupus nephritis.
items.abstract: Lupus nephritis (LN), a severe manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), is a heterogeneous disease driven by diverse immune and tissue cell types. We obtained 538,194 single-cell and 142,881 single-nuclear profiles from kidney biopsies of 155 patients with LN and 30 preimplantation transplant biopsy controls, along with 327,326 single-cell blood profiles. We characterized key stromal and immune cell types and cell states; moreover, we distinguished cell states that were tissue specific from those that were also present in the blood. We observed that LN pathological features were associated with particular cell states. For example, after controlling for the effects of chronic tissue damage, we observed that expansion of glomerular and scar-associated macrophage populations correlated with increasing inflammatory disease activity. Scar-associated macrophages appear to drive LN fibrosis and, in active disease, infiltrate the glomeruli more than other myeloid cells. These observations support that therapeutic targeting of myeloid populations may offer a strategy to prevent renal inflammation and ongoing kidney damage in LN.

items.titleZh: 狼疮性肾炎血液和组织的群体规模转录组图谱
items.abstractZh: 狼疮性肾炎（LN）是系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的一种严重表现，是一种由多种免疫和组织细胞类型驱动的异质性疾病。我们获得了来自155名LN患者和30名植入前移植活检对照的肾活检样本的538,194个单细胞和142,881个单核图谱，以及327,326个单细胞血液图谱。我们表征了关键的基质和免疫细胞类型及细胞状态；此外，我们区分了组织特异性的细胞状态与血液中也存在的细胞状态。我们观察到LN病理特征与特定细胞状态相关。例如，在控制慢性组织损伤的影响后，我们观察到肾小球和瘢痕相关巨噬细胞群体的扩增与炎症性疾病活动增加相关。瘢痕相关巨噬细胞似乎驱动LN纤维化，并且在活动性疾病中，比其他髓系细胞更多地浸润肾小球。这些观察结果支持治疗性靶向髓系群体可能提供一种预防LN肾脏炎症和持续肾损伤的策略。

items.title: Cost-effectiveness of herpes zoster vaccination in patients with rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: To assess the cost-effectiveness of vaccinating patients with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) with the adjuvanted recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV), compared with no vaccination. To predict health gains and costs from vaccination, we developed a decision-analytic Markov model with five health states: no herpes zoster, herpes zoster (HZ), postherpetic neuralgia (PHN), recovered from herpes zoster, and death. The model follows a hypothetical cohort of 10,000 patients with RA over a lifetime perspective and records events of HZ and PHN, along with quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) and costs from a healthcare perspective. Costs and health effects were discounted with 4% annually. Model inputs were collected from published literature and publicly available sources. Cost-effectiveness was evaluated using the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER), expressed as EUR per quality adjusted life year (QALY), compared with a cost-effectiveness threshold of EUR 23,650 per QALY. We performed one-way and probabilistic sensitivity analyses. Vaccination led to a reduction of 2,550 cases of HZ and 1,303 cases of PHN per 10,000 patients with RA vaccinated, resulting in an ICER of EUR 11,205/QALY. One-way sensitivity analyses revealed that the results were particularly sensitive to changes in the probability of developing PHN as a sequela of HZ. The probabilistic analysis indicated that the RZV had a 98% probability of being cost-effective at the assumed threshold value. Vaccinating patients with RA using RZV results in better health at higher cost compared with no vaccination. Under the assumptions made, vaccination is likely to be considered cost-effective for patients with RA.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎患者带状疱疹疫苗接种的成本效益分析
items.abstractZh: 旨在评估类风湿关节炎（RA）患者接种含佐剂重组带状疱疹疫苗（RZV）与不接种相比的成本效益。为预测接种带来的健康获益和成本，我们开发了一个决策分析马尔可夫模型，包含五种健康状态：无带状疱疹、带状疱疹（HZ）、带状疱疹后神经痛（PHN）、带状疱疹康复和死亡。该模型追踪一个假设的10,000名RA患者队列，采用终身视角，记录HZ和PHN事件，以及从医疗保健视角计算的质量调整生命年（QALYs）和成本。成本和健康效果按每年4%进行贴现。模型输入来自已发表文献和公开可用来源。成本效益通过增量成本效益比（ICER）评估，以每质量调整生命年（QALY）的欧元表示，并与每QALY 23,650欧元的成本效益阈值进行比较。我们进行了单因素和概率敏感性分析。接种疫苗使每10,000名接种疫苗的RA患者中HZ病例减少2,550例，PHN病例减少1,303例， resulting in an ICER of EUR 11,205/QALY。单因素敏感性分析显示，结果对HZ后遗症PHN发生概率的变化特别敏感。概率分析表明，在假设的阈值下，RZV具有98%的成本效益概率。使用RZV为RA患者接种疫苗与不接种相比，以更高成本获得更好的健康结果。在所做假设下，疫苗接种可能被认为对RA患者具有成本效益。

items.title: Real-world effectiveness of tofacitinib in monotherapy or in combination with csDMARDs in patients with rheumatoid arthritis: A collaboration between Dutch registries (TOFADUDAP study).
items.abstract: To compare real-world effectiveness of tofacitinib monotherapy to adalimumab monotherapy, and tofacitinib and adalimumab in combination with csDMARDs in Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) subgroups. Retrospective routine care data was used from six Dutch cohorts for RA patients who initiated tofacitinib or adalimumab between 2001 and 2022. Drug survival of tofacitinib monotherapy (n = 229) was compared with that of tofacitinib combination-therapy (n = 179), adalimumab monotherapy (n = 1019) and adalimumab combination-therapy (n = 1361) using Kaplan-Meier curves and Cox regression. Drug survival was evaluated as an indirect measure of treatment persistence. Exploratory analyses assessed effect modifications by anti-citrullinated protein antibody (ACPA) status and age at treatment onset in both models. Patients who started tofacitinib monotherapy were older compared to other treatment groups (61 vs 55, 58 and 58 years) and had used at least one previous b/tsDMARD more often compared to the adalimumab treatment groups (36% vs 41%, 19% and 13%). Compared to tofacitinib monotherapy, the risk of drug discontinuation was similar for tofacitinib combination-therapy (aHR 1.22, 95% CI: 0.96-1.54) and adalimumab monotherapy (aHR 0.89, 95% CI: 0.73-1.09) but lower for adalimumab combination-therapy (aHR 0.78, 95% CI: 0.63-0.96). Older age was associated with significantly higher risk of drug discontinuation. No effect modification by ACPA was observed. Based on real-world data from six Dutch cohorts, drug discontinuation was higher for tofacitinib than for adalimumab, with similar outcomes with or without csDMARDs. Older age was associated with a higher risk of drug discontinuation independently of treatment group, although this finding may be influenced by factors beyond treatment effectiveness. Key Points • In a real-world setting tofacitinib was observed to have similar drug survival in mono- and combination therapy • ACPA status did not influence drug survival • Older age was related to a higher risk of drug discontinuation independently of treatment.

items.titleZh: 托法替布单药治疗或与csDMARDs联合治疗类风湿关节炎患者的真实世界疗效：荷兰注册登记研究合作（TOFADUDAP研究）
items.abstractZh: 比较托法替布单药治疗与阿达木单抗单药治疗，以及托法替布和阿达木单抗分别与csDMARDs联合治疗在类风湿关节炎（RA）亚组中的真实世界疗效。使用来自六个荷兰队列的RA患者回顾性常规诊疗数据，这些患者在2001年至2022年间开始使用托法替布或阿达木单抗。采用Kaplan-Meier曲线和Cox回归比较托法替布单药治疗（n=229）与托法替布联合治疗（n=179）、阿达木单抗单药治疗（n=1019）和阿达木单抗联合治疗（n=1361）的药物存留率。药物存留率作为治疗持续性的间接指标进行评估。探索性分析评估了抗环瓜氨酸蛋白抗体（ACPA）状态和治疗起始年龄在两种模型中的效应修饰作用。开始托法替布单药治疗的患者比其他治疗组年龄更大（61岁对比55岁、58岁和58岁），且与阿达木单抗治疗组相比，既往使用过至少一种b/tsDMARD的比例更高（36%对比41%、19%和13%）。与托法替布单药治疗相比，托法替布联合治疗（aHR 1.22，95% CI：0.96-1.54）和阿达木单抗单药治疗（aHR 0.89，95% CI：0.73-1.09）的停药风险相似，但阿达木单抗联合治疗的停药风险较低（aHR 0.78，95% CI：0.63-0.96）。年龄较大与显著更高的停药风险相关。未观察到ACPA的效应修饰作用。基于六个荷兰队列的真实世界数据，托法替布的停药率高于阿达木单抗，无论是否联合csDMARDs，结果相似。年龄较大与更高的停药风险相关，且独立于治疗组，尽管这一发现可能受到治疗有效性之外因素的影响。要点• 在真实世界环境中，托法替布在单药治疗和联合治疗中的药物存留率相似• ACPA状态不影响药物存留率• 年龄较大与更高的停药风险相关，且独立于治疗。

items.title: In vivo analysis of Schlemm's canal axial dimensions in children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis-associated uveitis.
items.abstract: To evaluate Schlemm's canal (SC) axial dimensions using anterior segment optical coherence tomography (AS-OCT) in children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis-associated uveitis (JIA-U) and to investigate its relationship with uveitis-related prognostic factors. This cross-sectional study included 60 eyes of 30 children with JIA-U and 33 eyes of 33 healthy pediatric controls. Comprehensive ophthalmic examination, biometric measurements, anterior chamber angle (ACA) assessment, and Schlemm's canal axial length (SCAL) measurements were performed using AS-OCT at nasal and temporal locations with right nasal SCAL used for the between-group comparison. Inter-eye, inter-location, and group comparisons were conducted. Subgroup and correlation analyses evaluated associations between SCAL and JIA-U-related clinical prognostic factors. No significant differences were observed between right and left eyes or between nasal and temporal SCAL measurements in the JIA-U group. SCAL and ACA parameters did not differ significantly between the JIA-U and control groups (p > 0.05 for all). Correlation analysis revealed a location-specific significant negative association between uveitis duration and temporal SCAL in the right eye (r = - 0.489, p = 0.01). In JIA-U children with well-controlled inflammation and intraocular pressure, SC axial dimensions appear to be largely preserved. A location-specific, exploratory inverse association was observed between uveitis duration and right temporal SCAL. These results warrant confirmation in larger, prospective studies before any conclusions regarding the impact of disease duration on aqueous outflow structures can be drawn.

items.title: Managing Methotrexate Intolerance in Rheumatoid Arthritis: The Role of Oral-to-Subcutaneous Switching.
items.abstract: Methotrexate (MTX) remains the anchor drug in the management of rheumatoid arthritis (RA). However, its clinical use is frequently limited by intolerance, leading to dose reduction or discontinuation. In addition, oral MTX exhibits pharmacokinetic limitations, including dose-dependent absorption and reduced bioavailability at higher doses, which may compromise therapeutic efficacy. Subcutaneous (SC) MTX has emerged as a strategy to overcome these limitations by providing more consistent bioavailability and potentially improved tolerability. Evidence suggests that switching from oral-to-SC MTX may improve gastrointestinal (GI) intolerance and support treatment persistence, whereas evidence for improved disease control or reduction of serious MTX-related toxicity remains limited. Recent Japanese studies suggest the potential utility of this approach at MTX doses commonly used in Japan, although evidence for the superiority of SC MTX over oral MTX in low-dose settings remains limited. This narrative review summarizes current evidence on MTX intolerance and oral-to-SC route switching in RA, with a focus on practical strategies for treatment optimization. Overall, oral-to-SC MTX switching may represent an important option to improve GI intolerance and support treatment persistence in patients with RA.

items.title: Safety of intravenous and subcutaneous belimumab in Japanese patients with systemic lupus erythematosus: Final analysis of data from an all-case post-marketing surveillance study.
items.abstract: To assess safety of belimumab in Japanese patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) in real-world clinical practice. This all-case post-marketing surveillance study included patients initiating belimumab between December 2017 and October 2018. To evaluate safety, patients were observed for up to 52 weeks. In main population, baseline risk factors for serious infection were assessed by multivariate analysis. Exploratory risk factor analysis for depression/suicidal ideation/suicide attempt was conducted in expanded population. Among 1177 patients (main population), incidence rates per 100 person-years of serious adverse events (SAEs) and AEs of special interest were: SAEs, 28.4; serious infection, 8.8; depression/suicidal ideation/suicide attempt, 1.3; malignant tumour, 0.7; serious hypersensitivity, 0.7. Male sex, any comorbidity and glucocorticoid dose at baseline were independent risk factors for serious infection. In exploratory analysis, comorbidity of depression/suicidal ideation/suicide attempt at belimumab initiation was an associated characteristic factor for the new occurrence/worsening depression/suicidal ideation/suicide attempt. No new safety concerns were identified compared with previously reported data and current belimumab labelling. Depression/suicidal ideation/suicide attempt incidence rate was similar to that previously reported for patients with SLE. Patients with risk factors for serious infection and depression/suicidal ideation/suicide attempt should be carefully monitored.Clinicaltrials.gov: NCT03370263.

items.titleZh: 静脉和皮下注射贝利尤单抗在日本系统性红斑狼疮患者中的安全性：全病例上市后监测研究数据的最终分析
items.abstractZh: 评估贝利尤单抗在日本系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）患者真实世界临床实践中的安全性。这项全病例上市后监测研究纳入了2017年12月至2018年10月期间开始使用贝利尤单抗的患者。为评估安全性，对患者进行了长达52周的观察。在主要人群中，通过多变量分析评估了严重感染的基线风险因素。在扩展人群中进行了抑郁/自杀意念/自杀未遂的探索性风险因素分析。在1177名患者（主要人群）中，严重不良事件（SAEs）和特别关注的不良事件每100人年的发生率分别为：SAEs，28.4；严重感染，8.8；抑郁/自杀意念/自杀未遂，1.3；恶性肿瘤，0.7；严重超敏反应，0.7。男性、任何合并症和基线糖皮质激素剂量是严重感染的独立风险因素。在探索性分析中，贝利尤单抗启动时合并抑郁/自杀意念/自杀未遂是新发/加重抑郁/自杀意念/自杀未遂的相关特征因素。与先前报告的数据和当前贝利尤单抗说明书相比，未发现新的安全性问题。抑郁/自杀意念/自杀未遂的发生率与先前报告的SLE患者相似。应仔细监测具有严重感染和抑郁/自杀意念/自杀未遂风险因素的患者。临床试验注册号：NCT03370263。

items.title: Classification performance of the 2023 ACR/EULAR antiphospholipid syndrome criteria: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.abstract: To systematically evaluate the classification performance of the 2023 American College of Rheumatology/European Alliance of Associations for Rheumatology (ACR/EULAR) classification criteria for antiphospholipid syndrome (APS). We conducted a systematic review of literature from August 2023 through May 2026, including studies that evaluated the ability of the 2023 ACR/EULAR APS criteria to classify patients previously classified according to expert clinical diagnosis and/or the 2006 revised Sapporo (Sydney) criteria. Data on true and false positives and negatives were extracted. Sensitivity and specificity were pooled using a bivariate random-effects model when both parameters were available; sensitivity was additionally pooled using a univariate random-effects model. Twenty four studies comprising 25 data sets were included, of which 13 incorporated non-APS control groups. In the bivariate meta-analysis, pooled sensitivity was 0.74 (95%CI 0.67-0.81) and pooled specificity was 0.99 (95% CI 0.98-1.00). Sensitivity demonstrated substantial heterogeneity across studies and varied markedly by APS phenotype. Sensitivity was low in obstetric APS (pooled sensitivity 0.20 in studies restricted to obstetric APS and 0.31 when obstetric subgroup data from additional studies were included), whereas it was higher among cases of thrombotic APS (0.82). Across cohorts, non-classification was mainly driven by isolated IgM antiphospholipid antibody positivity and obstetric APS phenotypes. The 2023 ACR/EULAR APS classification criteria exhibit consistently excellent specificity but reduced and phenotype-dependent sensitivity. These findings reinforce the intended role of the criteria for classification rather than clinical diagnosis and highlight important limitations in specific APS subgroups.

items.titleZh: 2023年ACR/EULAR抗磷脂综合征分类标准的分类性能：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.abstractZh: 目的：系统评价2023年美国风湿病学会/欧洲风湿病联盟（ACR/EULAR）抗磷脂综合征（APS）分类标准的分类性能。方法：我们对2023年8月至2026年5月的文献进行了系统评价，纳入评估2023年ACR/EULAR APS标准对既往根据专家临床诊断和/或2006年修订的Sapporo（Sydney）标准分类的患者进行分类能力的研究。提取真阳性、假阳性、真阴性和假阴性数据。当敏感性和特异性均可用时，使用双变量随机效应模型合并；此外，使用单变量随机效应模型合并敏感性。结果：共纳入24项研究，包含25个数据集，其中13项包含非APS对照组。在双变量荟萃分析中，合并敏感性为0.74（95%CI 0.67-0.81），合并特异性为0.99（95% CI 0.98-1.00）。敏感性在研究间存在显著异质性，并随APS表型不同而显著变化。产科APS的敏感性较低（仅限于产科APS的研究中合并敏感性为0.20，纳入其他研究的产科亚组数据后为0.31），而血栓性APS病例的敏感性较高（0.82）。在各队列中，未分类主要由孤立性IgM抗磷脂抗体阳性和产科APS表型驱动。结论：2023年ACR/EULAR APS分类标准表现出持续优异的特异性，但敏感性降低且依赖于表型。这些发现强化了该标准用于分类而非临床诊断的预期作用，并强调了特定APS亚组中的重要局限性。

items.title: Anti-SRP immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy from childhood to adulthood: A case series highlighting rituximab-responsive disease.
items.abstract: ObjectivesAnti-signal recognition particle (SRP) myositis is a rare subset of immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy (IMNM). It is characterized by proximal muscle weakness, markedly elevated serum creatine kinase (CK) levels, and poor response to conventional therapies. Evidence for optimal management remains limited, particularly regarding the long-term outcomes of rituximab treatment.MethodWe retrospectively reviewed anti-SRP myositis patients who received rituximab at Seoul National University Hospital. Diagnosis was based on clinical features, elevated CK levels, and positivity for anti-SRP antibodies. Demographic, clinical, laboratory, radiological, histopathological, and treatment data were collected.ResultsFive patients, aged between 4 and 71 years, exhibited proximal muscle weakness, elevated CK levels, and variable disease severity. Rituximab induction followed by maintenance therapy led to a significant improvement in muscle strength and normalization of CK and aldolase levels. In patients with mild or subclinical phenotypes, aldolase elevations often preceded clinical relapses. Relapses during follow-up were managed with rituximab re-administration, which restored muscle strength and biochemical markers. MRI, EMG, and muscle biopsy findings were consistent with myopathic changes.ConclusionsThis case series highlights the heterogeneity in age, disease severity, and clinical course of anti-SRP myositis and the efficacy of rituximab in refractory and relapsing cases. Multimodal monitoring, including CK, aldolase, CD19+ B-cell counts, and clinical assessment, is essential for the early detection of relapses. Our findings support rituximab as a valuable component of individualized treatment strategies for anti-SRP myositis, though larger studies are warranted to establish standardized protocols and clarify long-term outcomes.

items.titleZh: 抗信号识别颗粒免疫介导坏死性肌病从儿童期到成年期：一个突出利妥昔单抗反应性疾病的病例系列
items.abstractZh: 目的抗信号识别颗粒（SRP）肌炎是免疫介导坏死性肌病（IMNM）的一种罕见亚型。其特征为近端肌无力、血清肌酸激酶（CK）水平显著升高，以及对常规治疗反应不佳。关于最佳治疗的证据仍然有限，尤其是利妥昔单抗治疗的长期结局。方法我们回顾性审查了在首尔国立大学医院接受利妥昔单抗治疗的抗SRP肌炎患者。诊断基于临床特征、CK水平升高以及抗SRP抗体阳性。收集了人口统计学、临床、实验室、放射学、组织病理学和治疗数据。结果5例年龄在4至71岁之间的患者表现出近端肌无力、CK水平升高和不同的疾病严重程度。利妥昔单抗诱导后维持治疗导致肌力显著改善，CK和醛缩酶水平恢复正常。在轻度或亚临床表型患者中，醛缩酶升高通常先于临床复发。随访期间的复发通过重新给予利妥昔单抗进行管理，这恢复了肌力和生化标志物。MRI、EMG和肌肉活检结果与肌病性改变一致。结论本病例系列强调了抗SRP肌炎在年龄、疾病严重程度和临床病程方面的异质性，以及利妥昔单抗在难治性和复发性病例中的疗效。多模式监测，包括CK、醛缩酶、CD19+ B细胞计数和临床评估，对于早期发现复发至关重要。我们的研究结果支持利妥昔单抗作为抗SRP肌炎个体化治疗策略的重要组成部分，尽管需要更大规模的研究来建立标准化方案并阐明长期结局。

items.title: Systemic effects of gout flares beyond the joints.
items.abstract: A gout flare is an episode of intense inflammation caused by the activation of NLR family pyrin domain containing 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome and production of interleukin (IL)-1β. This pathway is involved in pathogenesis of cardiovascular events and provides a plausible mechanism linking gout flares to cardiovascular diseases. Gout flares are associated with a transient increased risk of cardiovascular events (myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death), venous thromboembolism, and tachyarrhythmia in the subsequent 30-60  days - a finding comparable to that observed after other acute inflammatory states, such as influenza and pneumonia.Treat-to-target urate-lowering therapy lowered the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events in an emulated target trial. It also reduced systemic inflammation in observational studies. Additionally, gout flare prophylaxis with colchicine was associated with lower rates of major adverse cardiovascular events in a nationwide cohort study without evidence of residual confounding. Patients with gout are at a high risk of cardiovascular diseases. Recent data suggest that patients presenting with gout flares warrant heightened vigilance for cardiovascular events, venous thromboembolism, and tachyarrhythmia over the following 30-60 days. Treating gout to the target serum urate level could prevent cardiovascular events and renal function decline. Gout flare prophylaxis with colchicine may have a similar effect.

items.titleZh: 痛风发作超越关节的全身性影响
items.abstractZh: 痛风发作是由NLR家族含吡啶结构域3（NLRP3）炎症小体激活和白细胞介素（IL）-1β产生引起的强烈炎症发作。该通路参与心血管事件的发病机制，并为痛风发作与心血管疾病之间的联系提供了合理的机制。痛风发作与随后30-60天内心血管事件（心肌梗死、卒中和心血管死亡）、静脉血栓栓塞和快速性心律失常的短暂风险增加相关——这一发现与流感、肺炎等其他急性炎症状态后观察到的结果相当。在模拟目标试验中，达标降尿酸治疗降低了主要不良心血管事件的风险。观察性研究也显示其降低了全身性炎症。此外，在一项全国性队列研究中，秋水仙碱预防痛风发作与较低的主要不良心血管事件发生率相关，且无残余混杂的证据。痛风患者心血管疾病风险较高。近期数据表明，痛风发作患者在未来30-60天内需高度警惕心血管事件、静脉血栓栓塞和快速性心律失常。将痛风治疗至目标血清尿酸水平可预防心血管事件和肾功能下降。秋水仙碱预防痛风发作可能具有类似效果。

items.title: Beyond fibrinolysis: the multifaceted role of the fibrinolytic system in systemic sclerosis.
items.abstract: This review summarizes the emerging role of the fibrinolytic system in the pathogenesis of systemic sclerosis (SSc) and its potential as a source of novel therapeutic targets. Increasing evidence indicates that SSc is characterized by impaired fibrinolysis, largely driven by upregulation of plasminogen activator inhibitor-1 (PAI-1) and α2-antiplasmin, which limits extracellular matrix degradation and promotes myofibroblast differentiation. A key pathogenic mechanism involves matrix metalloproteinase-12-mediated proteolytic cleavage of the urokinase-type plasminogen activator receptor (uPAR), which compromises angiogenesis and promotes endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition, thereby contributing to both vascular remodeling and fibrosis. Moreover, aberrant crosstalk between cleaved uPAR and N-formyl peptide receptors (FPRs) on fibroblasts induces excessive reactive oxygen species generation and sustained fibroblast proliferation. Clinically, circulating soluble uPAR and PLAUR gene polymorphisms have emerged as candidate biomarkers of severe microvascular dysfunction and internal organ involvement. From a therapeutic perspective, several innovative strategies, including uPAR-targeting peptides, PAI-1 inhibitors, and molecules disrupting uPAR-FPR interaction, have shown encouraging antifibrotic efficacy in preclinical models. The fibrinolytic system has emerged as a central molecular hub linking SSc microvascular dysfunction, immune dysregulation, and fibrosis. Thus, restoring fibrinolytic homeostasis may offer a promising strategy to simultaneously improve angiogenesis, reduce fibrosis, and slow disease progression.

items.titleZh: 超越纤溶：纤溶系统在系统性硬化症中的多面作用
items.abstractZh: 本综述总结了纤溶系统在系统性硬化症（SSc）发病机制中的新兴作用及其作为新型治疗靶点来源的潜力。越来越多的证据表明，SSc的特征是纤溶功能受损，主要由纤溶酶原激活物抑制剂-1（PAI-1）和α2-抗纤溶酶的上调驱动，这限制了细胞外基质的降解并促进肌成纤维细胞分化。一个关键的致病机制涉及基质金属蛋白酶-12介导的尿激酶型纤溶酶原激活物受体（uPAR）的蛋白水解切割，这损害了血管生成并促进内皮-间质转化，从而同时导致血管重塑和纤维化。此外，切割后的uPAR与成纤维细胞上的N-甲酰肽受体（FPRs）之间的异常串扰诱导过量的活性氧生成和持续的成纤维细胞增殖。临床上，循环可溶性uPAR和PLAUR基因多态性已成为严重微血管功能障碍和内脏器官受累的候选生物标志物。从治疗角度来看，几种创新策略，包括uPAR靶向肽、PAI-1抑制剂和破坏uPAR-FPR相互作用的分子，在临床前模型中显示出令人鼓舞的抗纤维化疗效。纤溶系统已成为连接SSc微血管功能障碍、免疫失调和纤维化的中心分子枢纽。因此，恢复纤溶稳态可能提供一种有前景的策略，以同时改善血管生成、减少纤维化并减缓疾病进展。

items.title: Clinical application of genomic advances in systemic sclerosis.
items.abstract: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is a clinically heterogeneous chronic immune-mediated inflammatory disease with the highest mortality rate among all rheumatic diseases. Although current SSc clinical and serological classifications provide valuable prognostic information, predicting disease progression, and therapeutic responses remains challenging. In this context, genomics holds potential to bridge this gap. This review summarizes recent advances in SSc genomics and discusses their potential clinical applications in disease prediction, patient stratification, and therapeutic development. Over the past decade, genomic studies, mainly genome-wide association studies (GWAS) and sequencing-based approaches, have expanded our understanding of the genetic architecture of SSc, identifying susceptibility loci and pathways involved in immune dysregulation, vasculopathy, and fibrosis. Several approaches, including polygenic risk scores (PRS) and drug repurposing, have been performed with the potential to translate these results to clinical setting. Genomic discoveries in SSc are increasingly aiming to move beyond disease susceptibility towards clinically relevant applications. The integration of genomic, molecular, and clinical data may improve risk stratification, enable earlier identification of SSc patients at risk of severe complications, and support the development of personalized therapeutic strategies. Continued efforts in identifying causal variants and deciphering their underlying mechanisms through functional genomics will be essential for a better translation of genetic findings into precision medicine approaches for SSc.

items.titleZh: 基因组学进展在系统性硬化症中的临床应用
items.abstractZh: 系统性硬化症（SSc）是一种临床异质性慢性免疫介导的炎症性疾病，在所有风湿性疾病中死亡率最高。尽管目前SSc的临床和血清学分类提供了有价值的预后信息，但预测疾病进展和治疗反应仍具有挑战性。在此背景下，基因组学有望弥合这一差距。本综述总结了SSc基因组学的最新进展，并讨论了其在疾病预测、患者分层和治疗开发中的潜在临床应用。在过去十年中，基因组研究，主要是全基因组关联研究（GWAS）和基于测序的方法，扩展了我们对SSc遗传结构的理解，识别了涉及免疫失调、血管病变和纤维化的易感位点和通路。包括多基因风险评分（PRS）和药物再利用在内的几种方法已被实施，有望将这些结果转化为临床应用。SSc的基因组发现日益旨在超越疾病易感性，转向临床相关应用。基因组、分子和临床数据的整合可能改善风险分层，更早识别有严重并发症风险的SSc患者，并支持个体化治疗策略的开发。通过功能基因组学识别因果变异并阐明其潜在机制的持续努力，对于将遗传发现更好地转化为SSc的精准医学方法至关重要。

items.title: Antiangiogenic Effect of Pluchea lanceolata in Adjuvant-Induced Rheumatoid Arthritis in Wistar Rats by Downregulating VEGF Signaling Pathway and Proinflammatory Cytokines.
items.abstract: The current work aimed to investigate the therapeutic potential of Pluchea lanceolata (Rasna) in the management of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) using in silico, in vitro, and in vivo studies. After administering Rasna (aqueous and ethanolic extracts), physical parameters such as paw volume and arthritic score were found suppressed in rats (in Freund's complete adjuvant-induced model). Also, radiography and histopathological findings revealed that joint deformities, pannus formation, and tissue swelling of the ankle joint improved when compared with standard and arthritis-induced after 4 weeks. Simultaneously, ELISA results revealed that the serum levels of IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, C-reactive protein (CRP), and COL2A1 were lowered when compared with the standard group. An in silico study revealed that quercetin, isorhamnetin, and linalool were the potential active phytoconstituents and showed promising binding affinity toward targets such as KDR (VEGFR2), matrix metalloproteinase (MMPs), ALOX5, IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, CRP, and COL2A1. The biological mechanism of Rasna includes several molecular and cellular functions involving the downregulation of angiogenesis through the vascular endothelial growth factor signaling pathway, the MAPK signaling pathway, PI3K-Akt signaling pathway, and the reduction of cytokines and anti-collagen II antibodies. Rasna inhibits the activation of the abovementioned pathways and mRNA expression of IL-1β, IL-6, and TNF-α in RA. The study suggested the potential use of Rasna in managing arthritis treatment over the conventional therapy in immunocompromised patients.

items.titleZh: Pluchea lanceolata通过下调VEGF信号通路和促炎细胞因子在Wistar大鼠佐剂诱导的类风湿关节炎中的抗血管生成作用
items.abstractZh: 当前工作旨在通过计算机模拟、体外和体内研究，探讨Pluchea lanceolata（Rasna）在类风湿关节炎（RA）管理中的治疗潜力。给予Rasna（水提物和乙醇提取物）后，在弗氏完全佐剂诱导模型中，大鼠的物理参数如爪体积和关节炎评分受到抑制。此外，与标准组和关节炎诱导组相比，4周后放射学和组织病理学结果显示，关节畸形、血管翳形成和踝关节组织肿胀得到改善。同时，ELISA结果显示，与标准组相比，血清中IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α、C反应蛋白（CRP）和COL2A1水平降低。计算机模拟研究显示，槲皮素、异鼠李素和芳樟醇是潜在的活性植物成分，并对KDR（VEGFR2）、基质金属蛋白酶（MMPs）、ALOX5、IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α、CRP和COL2A1等靶点表现出有前景的结合亲和力。Rasna的生物学机制包括多种分子和细胞功能，涉及通过血管内皮生长因子信号通路、MAPK信号通路、PI3K-Akt信号通路下调血管生成，以及减少细胞因子和抗II型胶原抗体。Rasna抑制上述通路的激活以及RA中IL-1β、IL-6和TNF-α的mRNA表达。该研究提示，在免疫功能低下患者中，Rasna在关节炎治疗管理中可能具有替代常规疗法的潜在用途。

items.title: Efficacy and safety of golimumab biosimilar BAT2506 in patients with active psoriatic arthritis after switching from reference golimumab: 52-week results of a phase 3, double-blind, randomized study.
items.abstract: Switching from a reference biologic to a biosimilar can offer patients similar safety and efficacy while reducing healthcare costs and increasing treatment access. We report long-term efficacy and safety while switching from reference golimumab (Simponi; Ref-GLM) to BAT2506 in patients with active psoriatic arthritis during Treatment Period 2 (TP2; Week 24-52) of a confirmatory phase 3 study. Patients were randomized (1:2:1) to subcutaneous administration of Ref-GLM every 4 weeks to Week 48 (Ref-GLM group), or BAT2506 to Week 48 (BAT2506 group), or Ref-GLM to Week 24 followed by BAT2506 to Week 48 (Ref-GLM/BAT2506 group). Patients who completed TP1 at Week 24 entered TP2. Assessments through Week 52 included American College of Rheumatology 20/50/70 responses, disease activity score-28 C-reactive protein, safety, serum drug concentrations, anti-drug antibody, and neutralizing antibody incidence. 679 patients entered TP2. At Week 52, the efficacy endpoints showed no differences across any of the treatment groups. The incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events was comparable across groups, with no new safety signals. Pharmacokinetics (PK) profiles overlapped, and immunogenicity was comparable. Switching from Ref-GLM to BAT2506 showed comparable efficacy, safety, immunogenicity, and PK profiles to continued treatment with BAT2506 or Ref-GLM. www.clinicaltrials.gov identifier is NCT05046431.

items.titleZh: 戈利木单抗生物类似药BAT2506在活动性银屑病关节炎患者中从参照戈利木单抗转换后的疗效与安全性：一项3期、双盲、随机研究的52周结果
items.abstractZh: 从参照生物制剂转换为生物类似药可为患者提供相似的安全性和疗效，同时降低医疗成本并增加治疗可及性。我们报告了一项确证性3期研究的治疗期2（TP2；第24-52周）中，活动性银屑病关节炎患者从参照戈利木单抗（Simponi；Ref-GLM）转换为BAT2506的长期疗效和安全性。患者按1:2:1随机分配至每4周皮下注射Ref-GLM至第48周（Ref-GLM组）、BAT2506至第48周（BAT2506组）、或Ref-GLM至第24周后改用BAT2506至第48周（Ref-GLM/BAT2506组）。完成第24周TP1的患者进入TP2。至第52周的评估包括美国风湿病学会20/50/70应答、疾病活动度评分-28 C反应蛋白、安全性、血清药物浓度、抗药抗体和中和抗体发生率。679例患者进入TP2。第52周时，各治疗组的疗效终点无差异。治疗期间不良事件发生率在各组间相当，无新的安全信号。药代动力学（PK）曲线重叠，免疫原性相当。从Ref-GLM转换为BAT2506与继续BAT2506或Ref-GLM治疗相比，显示出相当的疗效、安全性、免疫原性和PK特征。www.clinicaltrials.gov标识符为NCT05046431。

items.title: Anaphylactic Induction of Lupus Nephritis and Posterior Reversible Encephalopathy Syndrome Following Administration of Depo-Provera.
items.abstract: Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a multifactorial autoimmune disease in which environmental and medication-related exposures may precipitate disease onset or flares in susceptible individuals, which can result in lupus nephritis (LN) and, in rare cases, posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES). Immediate hypersensitivity reactions preceding the initial presentation of SLE have rarely been described. We report that a 21-year-old Hispanic woman developed airway-compromising angioedema, encephalopathy, and generalized tonic-clonic seizures, requiring intubation after her first depot medroxyprogesterone acetate (DMPA) injection. Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) demonstrated PRES with extensive posterior vasogenic edema consistent with PRES with hemorrhagic transformation and bilateral posterior cerebral artery vasoconstriction. Laboratory evaluation revealed acute kidney injury with proteinuria, hypocomplementemia, positive antinuclear and antidouble-stranded DNA antibodies, and positive SSA antibodies. Kidney biopsy confirmed class IV diffuse LN. Treatment included pulse corticosteroids, seizure prophylaxis, immunosuppressants, and antihypertensive therapy, resulting in neurological and renal recovery. Although causality cannot be inferred, the temporal sequence raises the hypothesis that immune activation associated with DMPA exposure, or hypersensitivity to one of its excipients, may have contributed to the clinical unmasking of autoimmune disease.

items.titleZh: 注射Depo-Provera后诱发狼疮性肾炎和可逆性后部脑病综合征
items.abstractZh: 系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）是一种多因素自身免疫性疾病，在易感个体中，环境和药物相关暴露可能诱发疾病发作或复发，可导致狼疮性肾炎（LN），并在罕见情况下导致可逆性后部脑病综合征（PRES）。SLE初次发病前出现速发型超敏反应的情况鲜有报道。我们报告一例21岁西班牙裔女性，在首次注射醋酸甲羟孕酮缓释剂（DMPA）后出现危及气道的血管性水肿、脑病和全面性强直-阵挛发作，需要气管插管。脑磁共振成像（MRI）显示PRES，伴有广泛的后部血管源性水肿，符合伴出血转化的PRES，以及双侧大脑后动脉血管收缩。实验室检查显示急性肾损伤伴蛋白尿、低补体血症、抗核抗体和抗双链DNA抗体阳性，以及SSA抗体阳性。肾活检确诊为IV型弥漫性LN。治疗包括脉冲糖皮质激素、癫痫预防、免疫抑制剂和降压治疗，神经系统和肾脏功能得以恢复。尽管不能推断因果关系，但时间顺序提示，与DMPA暴露相关的免疫激活或对其辅料的超敏反应可能促进了自身免疫性疾病的临床显现。

items.title: Laryngeal Complications of Dermatomyositis: A Case Report and Comprehensive Review of the Literature.
items.abstract: Dermatomyositis is an immune-mediated inflammatory myopathy characterized by progressive proximal muscle weakness with sparing of distal muscles, accompanied by cutaneous manifestations. Laryngeal involvement in patients with dermatomyositis is extremely rare, with only seven cases described in the literature. We report the case of a 21-year-old man with dermatomyositis who presented with dysphonia, breathiness, and asthenia with a voice handicap index-10 score of 24/40. Laryngeal examination showed whitish mucosal patches on the upper surface of both vocal folds with bowing of the vocal folds. Video-stroboscopy revealed incomplete closure of the vocal folds during phonation, a decrease in vocal fold vibration amplitude, and diminished mucosal waves. One month after therapy with mycophenolate mofetil, the patient's voice quality improved and his VHI-10 score decreased to 16/40.

items.titleZh: 皮肌炎的喉部并发症：病例报告及文献全面综述
items.abstractZh: 皮肌炎是一种免疫介导的炎症性肌病，其特征为进行性近端肌无力，远端肌肉不受累，并伴有皮肤表现。皮肌炎患者的喉部受累极为罕见，文献中仅报道了七例。我们报告一例21岁男性皮肌炎患者，表现为发声困难、气息声和乏力，嗓音障碍指数-10评分为24/40。喉部检查显示双侧声带上表面有白色黏膜斑块，声带呈弓形。动态喉镜显示发声时声带闭合不全，声带振动幅度减小，黏膜波减弱。霉酚酸酯治疗一个月后，患者嗓音质量改善，VHI-10评分降至16/40。

items.title: Molecular mechanisms of biologic and targeted synthetic antirheumatic drugs in rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis is sustained by a synovial cytokine network that acquires the capacity to maintain inflammation independently of its initiating stimulus. The biologic and targeted synthetic antirheumatic drugs developed over the past two decades each interrupt this network at a defined molecular node, and their differential effects in patients therefore reveal how the network is organized. This review is structured around that principle, treating each agent as a probe of the axis it targets rather than as a therapeutic option. Following an account of the synovial signaling nodes on which diverse cytokines converge, four axes are examined: TNF-NF-κB, where receptor-level bifurcation between inflammatory and regulatory signaling defines the class; IL-6 and JAK-STAT, where classic and trans-signaling separate pathogenic from homeostatic function; costimulatory and lymphocyte-directed signaling, targeted by CTLA4-Ig and B-cell depletion; and the effector axes of tissue destruction driven by RANKL and GM-CSF. A recurring theme is that persistent synovitis reflects failure of the circuits that normally terminate cytokine signaling, and that fibroblast programs, once epigenetically imprinted, become progressively independent of the cytokines that established them. Synovial pathotypes correspond to differences in which axis is transcriptionally dominant, providing a biological rationale for stratified therapy; the same framework identifies a fibroblast-dominant state refractory to every current agent. Whether axis dominance is fixed or shifts under treatment remains the central unresolved question determining whether mechanism-guided therapy is clinically achievable.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中生物制剂和靶向合成抗风湿药的分子机制
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎由滑膜细胞因子网络维持，该网络获得独立于其起始刺激而维持炎症的能力。过去二十年间开发的生物制剂和靶向合成抗风湿药各自在该网络的一个明确分子节点处进行干预，因此它们在患者中的差异效应揭示了该网络的组织方式。本综述围绕这一原则展开，将每种药物视为其所靶向轴的探针，而非治疗选择。在阐述多种细胞因子汇聚的滑膜信号节点之后，本文考察了四个轴：TNF-NF-κB轴，其中受体水平的炎症信号与调节信号之间的分叉定义了该类别；IL-6和JAK-STAT轴，其中经典信号和反式信号将致病功能与稳态功能区分开来；共刺激和淋巴细胞导向信号，由CTLA4-Ig和B细胞耗竭靶向；以及由RANKL和GM-CSF驱动的组织破坏效应轴。一个反复出现的主题是，持续性滑膜炎反映了正常情况下终止细胞因子信号的回路失效，而成纤维细胞程序一旦被表观遗传印迹，便逐渐独立于建立它们的细胞因子。滑膜病理类型对应于哪个轴在转录水平上占主导地位的差异，为分层治疗提供了生物学依据；同一框架识别出一种对当前所有药物均难治的成纤维细胞主导状态。轴主导性是否固定或在治疗下发生转变，仍是决定机制引导治疗在临床上是否可实现的核心未解问题。

items.title: CD55 downregulation identifies a pathogenic CD4+ T cell axis linked to p38 MAPK signaling in rheumatoid arthritis.
items.abstract: CD4+ T cell dysfunction plays a critical role in the pathogenesis of rheumatoid arthritis (RA). In this study, we investigated the expression, phenotypic characteristics, and potential clinical significance of CD55, a membrane-bound complement regulatory protein, in peripheral blood CD4+ T cells from RA patients. Flow cytometric analysis revealed that CD55 expression was highest in naive CD4+ T cells and was significantly reduced in patients with early RA compared with healthy controls. Functionally, CD55+CD4+ T cells displayed enhanced production of IL-17, IL-21, and IL-22 following stimulation and exhibited reduced susceptibility to complement deposition. Transcriptomic analysis identified distinct molecular signatures associated with CD55 expression, which were further validated at the protein level, including increased expression of PAX5, CR2, and CD248 in CD55+CD4+ T cells. In addition, CD55 expression was inversely associated with p38 MAPK activation, suggesting a link between CD55 downregulation and aberrant T cell activation. Receiver operating characteristic analysis demonstrated that CD55+CD4+ T cell frequency possessed diagnostic value for distinguishing patients with early RA from healthy controls and primary Sjögren's syndrome patients. Collectively, these findings identify CD55 as a marker of a distinct CD4+ T cell subset with altered functional and molecular characteristics and support its potential utility in the early diagnosis and differential diagnosis of RA.

items.titleZh: CD55下调识别类风湿关节炎中与p38 MAPK信号相关的致病性CD4+ T细胞轴
items.abstractZh: CD4+ T细胞功能障碍在类风湿关节炎（RA）的发病机制中起关键作用。在本研究中，我们探讨了CD55（一种膜结合补体调节蛋白）在RA患者外周血CD4+ T细胞中的表达、表型特征及潜在临床意义。流式细胞术分析显示，CD55在初始CD4+ T细胞中表达最高，且与健康对照相比，早期RA患者中CD55表达显著降低。功能上，CD55+CD4+ T细胞在刺激后表现出IL-17、IL-21和IL-22产生增强，并对补体沉积的易感性降低。转录组学分析确定了与CD55表达相关的独特分子特征，并在蛋白质水平进一步验证，包括CD55+CD4+ T细胞中PAX5、CR2和CD248表达增加。此外，CD55表达与p38 MAPK激活呈负相关，提示CD55下调与异常T细胞激活之间存在联系。受试者工作特征分析表明，CD55+CD4+ T细胞频率对区分早期RA患者与健康对照及原发性干燥综合征患者具有诊断价值。总的来说，这些发现将CD55确定为具有改变的功能和分子特征的独特CD4+ T细胞亚群的标志物，并支持其在RA早期诊断和鉴别诊断中的潜在用途。

items.title: Rewiring immunity in rheumatoid arthritis: metabolic and epigenetic therapeutic strategies.
items.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a systemic autoimmune disease marked by chronic inflammation and destruction of joints and surrounding soft tissues. The pathogenesis of RA is heavily driven by two intertwined and mutually regulatory processes: metabolic reprogramming and epigenetic remodeling. Recent advances reveal a crucial crosstalk wherein metabolic intermediates derived from immune cells act as substrates or cofactors for chromatin-modifying enzymes. This interplay profoundly shapes epigenetic landscapes, thereby exacerbating inflammatory responses and disease progression. Here, we review the mechanisms underlying immune cell metabolic reprogramming in RA and critically examine how metabolite-mediated epigenetic remodeling orchestrates disease pathology. Furthermore, we summarize state-of-the-art epigenetic-targeted therapeutic strategies, offering new insights and a solid theoretical basis for treating RA through the metabolic-epigenetic axis.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎中的免疫重塑：代谢与表观遗传治疗策略
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）是一种系统性自身免疫性疾病，以慢性炎症及关节和周围软组织破坏为特征。RA的发病机制主要由两个相互交织且相互调节的过程驱动：代谢重编程和表观遗传重塑。近期进展揭示了关键的串扰，其中来源于免疫细胞的代谢中间产物作为染色质修饰酶的底物或辅因子。这种相互作用深刻塑造表观遗传景观，从而加剧炎症反应和疾病进展。在此，我们综述了RA中免疫细胞代谢重编程的机制，并批判性地审视代谢物介导的表观遗传重塑如何协调疾病病理。此外，我们总结了最先进的表观遗传靶向治疗策略，为通过代谢-表观遗传轴治疗RA提供新见解和坚实的理论基础。

items.title: Macrophage polarization in Sjögren's syndrome: from mechanisms to therapeutic translation.
items.abstract: Sjögren's syndrome (SS) is a chronic systemic autoimmune disease characterized by damage to exocrine glands, and no effective treatment is currently available to reverse glandular fibrosis. As core effector cells of innate immunity, macrophages play a pivotal role in the dynamic imbalance of polarization states, which critically influences inflammation initiation, tissue injury, and irreversible fibrosis in SS. This review systematically delineates the heterogeneity of M1/M2 macrophage subsets, their spatiotemporal dynamics, and their functional transitions across different pathological stages of SS: M1 predominance drives early pro-inflammatory damage, M1/M2 interplay sustains chronic inflammation in the middle stage, and aberrant M2 polarization promotes late-stage glandular fibrosis. We further dissect the multi-level regulatory network underlying macrophage polarization imbalance, including immune cell crosstalk, core signaling pathways, non-coding RNA epigenetic regulation, and immunometabolic reprogramming. The in-depth mechanisms by which M2 macrophages drive the progression of glandular fibrosis are also summarized. In this context, we describe how certain traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) formulas and monomeric compounds can effectively restore the balance of macrophage polarization by targeting relevant pathways and molecular nodes. Moreover, we analyze the major bottlenecks currently hindering the clinical translation of macrophage-targeted strategies and propose innovative approaches, including tissue-specific delivery, spatiotemporally tailored modulation, integrated TCM-western medicine therapy, biomarker-guided patient stratification, and early-window intervention. Finally, we discuss the potential of cutting-edge technologies such as single-cell multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, gene editing, and organoid models to decode the heterogeneity of macrophage subsets and their interactions with the microenvironment. Integration of these multidisciplinary tools will facilitate the development of safe, effective, and personalized therapeutic strategies targeting macrophage polarization for SS.

items.title: The chemokine network in lupus nephritis: pathogenesis, targeted therapies, and future directions.
items.abstract: Lupus nephritis (LN) is a severe complication of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), affecting more than 50% of SLE patients and remaining a leading cause of end-stage renal disease (ESRD) worldwide. Current standard therapies-glucocorticoids combined with conventional immunosuppressants-fail to achieve sustained remission in 30%-40% of patients and are associated with substantial toxicities, including infections, osteoporosis, and cardiovascular disease. The chemokine system, composed of small secreted proteins and their G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), plays a central role in LN pathogenesis by orchestrating pathogenic immune cell infiltration, renal inflammation, and progressive fibrosis. This review synthesizes preclinical and clinical evidence establishing the chemokine network as a rational therapeutic target in LN. We first outline the clinical burden of LN and the limitations of existing therapies, followed by a systematic overview of chemokine biology (classification, structural interactions, and leukocyte trafficking functions). Next, we dissect the pathogenic roles of chemokines in LN, focusing on their secretion by resident renal cells, regulation of immune cell infiltration, and association with renal fibrosis. Subsequently, we evaluate therapeutic advances targeting chemokines, including small-molecule antagonists, monoclonal antibodies, and upstream pathway interventions, while discussing translational challenges (e.g., preclinical-clinical disconnect, complexity of target selection, safety concerns). Finally, we highlight emerging technologies, opportunities for personalized medicine, and long-term research priorities to facilitate the development of chemokine-based therapeutic strategies for LN.

items.titleZh: 狼疮性肾炎中的趋化因子网络：发病机制、靶向治疗与未来方向
items.abstractZh: 狼疮性肾炎（LN）是系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）的严重并发症，影响超过50%的SLE患者，并且仍然是全球终末期肾病（ESRD）的主要原因。当前的标准治疗——糖皮质激素联合传统免疫抑制剂——在30%-40%的患者中未能实现持续缓解，并且与显著的毒性相关，包括感染、骨质疏松和心血管疾病。趋化因子系统由小分泌蛋白及其G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）组成，在LN发病机制中通过协调致病性免疫细胞浸润、肾脏炎症和进行性纤维化发挥核心作用。本综述综合了临床前和临床证据，确立趋化因子网络作为LN的合理治疗靶点。我们首先概述LN的临床负担和现有疗法的局限性，随后系统概述趋化因子生物学（分类、结构相互作用和白细胞运输功能）。接下来，我们剖析趋化因子在LN中的致病作用，重点关注其由肾固有细胞分泌、调节免疫细胞浸润以及与肾纤维化的关联。随后，我们评估靶向趋化因子的治疗进展，包括小分子拮抗剂、单克隆抗体和上游通路干预，同时讨论转化挑战（例如，临床前与临床脱节、靶点选择的复杂性、安全性问题）。最后，我们强调新兴技术、个性化医疗的机会和长期研究优先事项，以促进基于趋化因子的LN治疗策略的开发。

items.title: Tocilizumab-induced inflammatory flare in Takayasu arteritis: a case report with exploratory mechanistic findings of Fcγ receptor involvement.
items.abstract: To report a refractory Takayasu arteritis (TAK) patient who developed a severe inflammatory flare after tocilizumab (TCZ) therapy and explore the underlying mechanism. A 21-year-old female with active TAK received TCZ after insufficient response to prednisone. TCZ was temporarily withheld then re-added at 400 mg due to disease relapse. After TCZ reintroduction, the patient developed worsening vascular pain, new abdominal pain, dizziness, fever, and markedly elevated inflammatory markers. Imaging showed worsened arteritis and new superior mesenteric arteritis. Methylprednisolone pulse and infliximab failed to control the flare, but tofacitinib achieved complete symptom resolution and normalized inflammatory markers within one month. Peripheral blood samples of the patient were collected and peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) Fcγ receptor (FcγR) expression and downstream signaling were assessed upon TCZ stimulation. In vitro studies showed that increasing TCZ concentrations were associated with enhanced FcγRIIA, FcγRIIB, and FcγRI expression, along with increased spleen tyrosine kinase (SYK) phosphorylation in the patient's PBMCs. TCZ can paradoxically trigger an inflammatory flare in refractory TAK, with exploratory evidence suggesting possible involvement of excessive FcγR activation. Non-antibody-based Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitors like tofacitinib may be effective rescue therapy in such cases.

items.titleZh: 托珠单抗诱发的大动脉炎炎症发作：一例病例报告及Fcγ受体参与的探索性机制研究
items.abstractZh: 报告一例难治性大动脉炎（TAK）患者在接受托珠单抗（TCZ）治疗后出现严重炎症发作，并探讨其潜在机制。一名21岁女性活动性TAK患者，在泼尼松治疗反应不足后接受TCZ治疗。因疾病复发，TCZ暂时停用后以400 mg剂量重新加用。TCZ重新引入后，患者出现血管疼痛加重、新发腹痛、头晕、发热及炎症标志物显著升高。影像学显示动脉炎加重并新发肠系膜上动脉炎。甲泼尼龙冲击治疗和英夫利西单抗未能控制发作，但托法替布在一个月内实现症状完全缓解并恢复正常炎症标志物。收集患者外周血样本，评估TCZ刺激下外周血单个核细胞（PBMCs）Fcγ受体（FcγR）表达及下游信号传导。体外研究表明，TCZ浓度增加与患者PBMCs中FcγRIIA、FcγRIIB和FcγRI表达增强以及脾酪氨酸激酶（SYK）磷酸化增加相关。TCZ可矛盾性地触发难治性TAK的炎症发作，探索性证据提示可能涉及FcγR过度激活。非抗体类Janus激酶（JAK）抑制剂如托法替布在此类病例中可能是有效的挽救治疗。

items.title: Circulating long non-coding RNAs as diagnostic markers of lupus nephritis and 5-year follow-up disease flares.
items.abstract: Emerging evidence underscores the pivotal role of long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) as epigenetic regulators in the immunopathogenesis of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). There is a paucity of comprehensive studies that investigate lncRNA associated with lupus nephritis (LN) and disease flares. Thus, we aimed to identify a specific circulating lncRNA panel with high diagnostic accuracy of LN and predictive power of disease flare incidence. To investigate the feasibility of early diagnosis of LN and disease flares, we examined lncRNAs present in plasma obtained from patients with SLE ( n = 96) and healthy individuals (CNT) ( n  = 25). Non-coding RNA sequencing analysis was used to determine lncRNA in plasma, and the ability to diagnose renal damage and disease flares in a 5-year follow-up study was estimated by the area under the curve (AUC) and by using multivariate Cox's proportional hazards regression. From the ncRNA sequencing results, we identified 9,155 circulating lncRNAs and 148 differentially expressed between patients with SLE and CNT. Seven of these lncRNAs (AL139317.5, AC019080.1, LINC02185, LINC00708, AC239868.1, AC087392.4, and LATS2-AS1) presented statistically significant high expression for the discrimination of the LN (AUC ≥ 0.90), along with high specificity and positive predictive values (≥80%). A panel combining the 7-lncRNA gave an AUC that improved the read count of the single lncRNAs (1.000, p  < 0.00001). In addition, six of these lncRNAs were associated with disease flares (AUC ≥ 0.64) and the 4-lncRNA panel was an independent predictor of disease flares (odds ratio = 8.71, p  = 0.005 with a c statistic of 0.864, p  < 0.0001), with high levels being a strong independent predictor of 60-month follow-up flares (hazard ratio 4.75, p  = 0.005). Higher plasma 4-lncRNA panel values were also related to shorter time free of lupus flares. Finally, functional pathway analysis revealed that the lncRNA-miRNA-target gene network was linked to various inflammation pathways (MAPK, JAK-STAT, and p53 signaling pathways) in immune dysregulation and tissue damage in SLE (TGF-β signaling) and regulation of actin cytoskeleton (adherens junction and focal adhesion). We identified, for the first time, a specific lncRNA expression profile associated with renal damage and an increased incidence of 5-year follow-up disease flares in patients with SLE, being excellent predictive biomarkers for disease activity and organ damage.

items.titleZh: 循环长链非编码RNA作为狼疮性肾炎及5年随访疾病发作的诊断标志物
items.abstractZh: 新出现的证据强调了长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）作为表观遗传调控因子在系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）免疫发病机制中的关键作用。目前缺乏全面研究lncRNA与狼疮性肾炎（LN）及疾病发作相关性的报道。因此，我们旨在鉴定具有高诊断准确性LN和预测疾病发作发生率特异性的循环lncRNA组合。为探讨LN和疾病发作早期诊断的可行性，我们检测了SLE患者（n=96）和健康个体（CNT）（n=25）血浆中的lncRNAs。采用非编码RNA测序分析确定血浆中的lncRNA，并通过曲线下面积（AUC）和多变量Cox比例风险回归评估其在5年随访研究中诊断肾损伤和疾病发作的能力。从ncRNA测序结果中，我们鉴定出9,155个循环lncRNAs，其中148个在SLE患者和CNT之间差异表达。其中7个lncRNAs（AL139317.5、AC019080.1、LINC02185、LINC00708、AC239868.1、AC087392.4和LATS2-AS1）在区分LN方面表现出统计学上显著的高表达（AUC≥0.90），且具有高特异性和阳性预测值（≥80%）。结合7-lncRNA的组合给出的AUC优于单个lncRNA的读数（1.000，p<0.00001）。此外，其中6个lncRNAs与疾病发作相关（AUC≥0.64），4-lncRNA组合是疾病发作的独立预测因子（比值比=8.71，p=0.005，c统计量为0.864，p<0.0001），高水平是60个月随访发作的强独立预测因子（风险比4.75，p=0.005）。较高的血浆4-lncRNA组合值也与较短的无狼疮发作时间相关。最后，功能通路分析显示，lncRNA-miRNA-靶基因网络与SLE免疫失调和组织损伤中的各种炎症通路（MAPK、JAK-STAT和p53信号通路）相关（TGF-β信号通路）以及肌动蛋白细胞骨架的调节（粘附连接和粘着斑）。我们首次鉴定了与SLE患者肾损伤和5年随访疾病发作发生率增加相关的特异性lncRNA表达谱，这些lncRNAs是疾病活动和器官损伤的极佳预测生物标志物。

items.title: The association between SGLT2 inhibitors and rheumatoid arthritis risk in type 2 diabetes: findings from large-scale emulated target trials.
items.abstract: Globally, the prevalence of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is on the rise. Certain antidiabetic medications have been reported to lower the risk of RA. In this study, we conducted multicenter emulated target trials to compare the risk of RA development between sodium-glucose cotransporter-2 inhibitors (SGLT2i) and non-SGLT2i treatment options in patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). We identified 4,991,988 patients with T2DM from the TriNetX network between January 1, 2016, to June 30, 2023. From this cohort, we selected 310,507, 206,069, and 80,846 propensity score-matched pairs of patients using SGLT2i versus sulfonylureas, dipeptidyl peptidase-4 inhibitors (DPP-4i), and pioglitazone, respectively. The Kaplan-Meier method was used to determine the relative hazards of developing RA among these groups. Subgroup analyses were conducted based on sex, age, race, obesity status, HbA1C levels, and eGFR, with an additional sensitivity analysis using the intention-to-treat approach. SGLT2i use was associated with a significantly lower risk of incident RA compared to sulfonylurea use (HR: 0.899, 95% CI: 0.835-0.968). However, there was no significant difference in RA risk when comparing SGLT2i with DPP-4 inhibitors (HR: 0.914, 95% CI: 0.831-1.005) or pioglitazone (HR: 0.922, 95% CI: 0.796-1.068). Kaplan-Meier curves demonstrated that SGLT2i users had a significantly lower likelihood of developing RA than sulfonylurea users (log-rank p = 0.004). Subgroup analyses further indicated that SGLT2i use was consistently associated with a lower risk of RA across all analyzed patient subgroups compared to sulfonylureas. Additionally, sensitivity analyses confirmed the robustness of these findings, aligning with the results from the emulated target trial comparing SGLT2i to sulfonylureas. This study found that SGLT2i use was associated with a lower risk of incident RA compared with sulfonylurea use among patients with T2DM. However, because of the observational study design, these findings should be interpreted as associations rather than evidence of causality.

items.titleZh: SGLT2抑制剂与2型糖尿病患者类风湿关节炎风险的关联：来自大规模模拟目标试验的结果
items.abstractZh: 全球范围内，类风湿关节炎（RA）的患病率正在上升。有报道称某些降糖药物可降低RA风险。在本研究中，我们开展了多中心模拟目标试验，以比较2型糖尿病（T2DM）患者中使用钠-葡萄糖协同转运蛋白2抑制剂（SGLT2i）与非SGLT2i治疗方案之间发生RA的风险。我们从TriNetX网络中识别出2016年1月1日至2023年6月30日期间的4,991,988例T2DM患者。从该队列中，我们分别筛选出使用SGLT2i与磺脲类、二肽基肽酶-4抑制剂（DPP-4i）和吡格列酮的倾向评分匹配患者对310,507对、206,069对和80,846对。采用Kaplan-Meier方法确定这些组中发生RA的相对风险。根据性别、年龄、种族、肥胖状态、HbA1C水平和eGFR进行亚组分析，并使用意向性治疗分析方法进行了额外的敏感性分析。与磺脲类使用相比，SGLT2i使用与RA发生风险显著降低相关（HR：0.899，95% CI：0.835-0.968）。然而，与DPP-4抑制剂（HR：0.914，95% CI：0.831-1.005）或吡格列酮（HR：0.922，95% CI：0.796-1.068）相比，SGLT2i的RA风险无显著差异。Kaplan-Meier曲线显示，SGLT2i使用者发生RA的可能性显著低于磺脲类使用者（log-rank p = 0.004）。亚组分析进一步表明，与磺脲类相比，SGLT2i使用在所有分析的患者亚组中均与较低的RA风险一致相关。此外，敏感性分析证实了这些发现的稳健性，与比较SGLT2i和磺脲类的模拟目标试验结果一致。本研究发现，在T2DM患者中，与磺脲类使用相比，SGLT2i使用与RA发生风险降低相关。然而，由于观察性研究设计，这些发现应被解释为关联而非因果证据。

items.title: Inflammatory Myopathy in a Case of Primary Sjögren's Syndrome on Chronic Statin Therapy: A Diagnostic Challenge and Rare Clinical Presentation.
items.abstract: Primary Sjögren's syndrome (pSS) is a systemic autoimmune disease primarily affecting exocrine glands, with less frequent but significant extraglandular manifestations. Among these, inflammatory myopathy (IM) is rare, particularly in biopsy-proven cases. We report the case of a 63-year-old female with a history of hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and chronic statin use who presented with progressive, symmetric proximal muscle weakness of 8 months' duration. Neurological examination revealed flaccid weakness without sensory involvement. Laboratory evaluation showed markedly elevated creatine phosphokinase levels and positive anti-HMG-CoA reductase and anti-Ro52 antibodies. Magnetic resonance imaging of the thighs demonstrated diffuse myoedema. Muscle biopsy revealed myonecrosis, myophagocytosis, and lymphocytic infiltration, consistent with IM. Schirmer's test and salivary gland biopsy confirmed the diagnosis of pSS. IM may rarely occur in pSS and can be easily overlooked in the context of long-term statin use. A high index of suspicion, combined with detailed immunologic workup and tissue biopsy, is essential for accurate diagnosis and timely immunosuppressive therapy. Résumé Le syndrome de Sjögren primitif (SSp) est une maladie auto-immune systémique touchant principalement les glandes exocrines, avec des manifestations extraglandulaires moins fréquentes mais cliniquement significatives. Parmi celles-ci, la myopathie inflammatoire (MI) est rare, en particulier dans les cas confirmés par biopsie. Nous rapportons le cas d’une femme de 63 ans, ayant des antécédents d’hypertension artérielle, de diabète de type 2 et de prise chronique de statines, qui s’est présentée avec une faiblesse musculaire proximale progressive et symétrique évoluant depuis huit mois. L’examen neurologique a mis en évidence une faiblesse flasque sans atteinte sensitive. Le bilan biologique a révélé une élévation marquée de la créatine phosphokinase ainsi que la positivité des anticorps anti-HMG-CoA réductase et anti-Ro52. L’imagerie par résonance magnétique des cuisses a montré un myœdème diffus. La biopsie musculaire a mis en évidence une myonécrose, une myophagocytose et un infiltrat lymphocytaire, compatibles avec une myopathie inflammatoire. Le test de Schirmer et la biopsie des glandes salivaires ont confirmé le diagnostic de SSp. La MI peut survenir rarement au cours du SSp et être facilement méconnue dans le contexte d’une utilisation prolongée des statines. Un haut niveau de suspicion clinique, associé à un bilan immunologique approfondi et à une confirmation histologique, est essentiel pour établir un diagnostic précis et instaurer rapidement un traitement immunosuppresseur approprié.

items.title: Goose kidney organoids: A new model for studying the metabolic mechanism of goose astrovirus-induced gout.
items.abstract: Goose astrovirus (GAstV) is a newly identified avian pathogen that causes fatal gout in goslings, characterized by kidney damage and high mortality. Unlike non-pathogenic human gout, GAstV-induced gout lacks reference models due to the absence of goose-derived cell lines and standard experimental animals, limiting mechanistic studies. Here, primary goose kidney organoids (GKOs) were isolated from 28-day-old goose embryos. GKOs retained physiological structures and functions comparable to in vivo kidneys. GAstV infection in GKOs was evaluated across renal cell lineages and compared with in vivo outcomes. Viral replication and effects on uric acid metabolism were assessed at different multiplicities of infection. GAstV readily infected GKOs, targeting progenitor, pluripotent stem, collecting duct, and renal tubular cells, consistent with in vivo findings. At a multiplicity of infection of 10.0, GAstV rapidly induced a significant elevation of uric acid, whereas lower doses had weaker effects, paralleling disease severity in goslings. In contrast, GAstV replication was minimal in 2D cells, and other avian viruses failed to induce uric acid elevation in GKOs. Post-infection, transcriptomic and metabolomic analysis showed GAstV remodeled global gene expression and metabolism, mainly disrupting purine metabolism pathways. GAstV infection significantly increased mRNA levels of SLC22A23, SLC17A5, and SLC13A3, which were correlated positively with uric acid. GKOs provide a physiologically relevant model for elucidating GAstV pathogenesis, offering new insights into virus-induced gout and a platform for studying goose viral diseases.

items.titleZh: 鹅肾类器官：研究鹅星状病毒诱导痛风代谢机制的新模型
items.abstractZh: 鹅星状病毒（GAstV）是一种新发现的禽类病原体，可导致雏鹅致命性痛风，其特征为肾脏损伤和高死亡率。与非致病性人类痛风不同，GAstV诱导的痛风由于缺乏鹅源细胞系和标准实验动物而缺少参考模型，限制了机制研究。在此，从28日龄鹅胚胎中分离出原代鹅肾类器官（GKOs）。GKOs保留了与体内肾脏相当的生理结构和功能。在肾细胞谱系中评估了GKOs中的GAstV感染，并与体内结果进行了比较。在不同感染复数下评估了病毒复制及其对尿酸代谢的影响。GAstV易于感染GKOs，靶向祖细胞、多能干细胞、集合管和肾小管细胞，与体内发现一致。在感染复数为10.0时，GAstV迅速诱导尿酸显著升高，而较低剂量则效果较弱，与雏鹅的疾病严重程度平行。相比之下，GAstV在2D细胞中复制极少，其他禽类病毒未能诱导GKOs中尿酸升高。感染后，转录组学和代谢组学分析显示GAstV重塑了全局基因表达和代谢，主要干扰嘌呤代谢途径。GAstV感染显著增加了SLC22A23、SLC17A5和SLC13A3的mRNA水平，这些与尿酸呈正相关。GKOs为阐明GAstV发病机制提供了生理相关模型，为病毒诱导的痛风提供了新见解，并为研究鹅病毒性疾病提供了平台。

items.title: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis-Macrophage Activation Syndrome (HLH-MAS) Mimicking Neuropsychiatric Lupus in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE).
items.abstract: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis-macrophage activation syndrome (HLH-MAS) is a life-threatening hyperinflammatory syndrome that can complicate systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and present with neurologic manifestations that mimic neuropsychiatric SLE (NPSLE). A 28-year-old woman with a four-year history of SLE initially presented to the emergency department of a community hospital with acute altered mental status and mutism. Laboratory evaluation revealed pancytopenia, markedly elevated ferritin (8,670 ng/mL), hypertriglyceridemia, and hypofibrinogenemia with an erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) that declined from 21 to 6 mm/hr despite active inflammation, a recognized clue distinguishing HLH-MAS from NPSLE. Extensive infectious workup was negative. Although bone marrow biopsy and specialized biomarkers were unavailable at the presenting community hospital, an HScore of 271 (>99% probability of reactive hemophagocytic syndrome) strongly supported the diagnosis of HLH-MAS. High-dose IV methylprednisolone resulted in a progressive decline in ferritin and partial improvement in clinical status, following which the patient was transferred to a tertiary care center for further management. Early recognition of HLH-MAS in SLE patients presenting with acute neurologic symptoms is critical, as misdiagnosis can delay appropriate treatment.

items.titleZh: 噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症-巨噬细胞活化综合征（HLH-MAS）模拟系统性红斑狼疮（SLE）中的神经精神性狼疮
items.abstractZh: 噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增生症-巨噬细胞活化综合征（HLH-MAS）是一种危及生命的过度炎症综合征，可并发系统性红斑狼疮（SLE），并出现类似神经精神性狼疮（NPSLE）的神经系统表现。一名有四年SLE病史的28岁女性，最初因急性精神状态改变和缄默症就诊于社区医院急诊科。实验室检查显示全血细胞减少、铁蛋白显著升高（8,670 ng/mL）、高甘油三酯血症和低纤维蛋白原血症，红细胞沉降率（ESR）从21 mm/hr降至6 mm/hr，尽管存在活动性炎症，这是区分HLH-MAS与NPSLE的一个公认线索。广泛的感染检查均为阴性。尽管就诊的社区医院无法进行骨髓活检和特异性生物标志物检测，但HScore为271（反应性噬血细胞综合征概率>99%）强烈支持HLH-MAS的诊断。大剂量IV甲泼尼龙治疗后，铁蛋白水平逐渐下降，临床状况部分改善，随后患者被转至三级医疗中心进一步治疗。在出现急性神经系统症状的SLE患者中，早期识别HLH-MAS至关重要，因为误诊可能延误适当治疗。

items.title: Sex differences in axial spondyloarthritis: biological mechanisms, clinical phenotypes, and therapeutic implications - a narrative review.
items.abstract: Sex differences in axial spondyloarthritis (axSpA) are gaining recognition as clinically significant, but they are still not well incorporated into diagnostic practice and outcome assessment. Although long viewed as a predominantly male disease, axSpA affects women at nearly comparable rates and often follows a distinct phenotype. These differences extend beyond variations in severity and appear to reflect different biological and clinical expressions of disease. Women with axSpA typically report higher levels of pain, fatigue, and disease activity, frequently alongside lower inflammatory markers and slower radiographic progression. They also experience longer diagnostic delays and more often present with peripheral manifestations or overlapping pain conditions such as fibromyalgia. In contrast, men more commonly exhibit the classical axial phenotype, elevated C-reactive protein, and greater structural damage. This discordance between symptom burden and objective inflammation creates challenges for disease assessment, as conventional tools may not perform equally across sexes. Emerging evidence also indicates sex-related differences in treatment response and drug persistence. Recognizing sex as a biological determinant of disease expression, rather than merely a covariate for statistical adjustment, offers an opportunity to improve diagnostic precision, refine outcome interpretation, and support more individualized patient care.

items.titleZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎的性别差异：生物学机制、临床表型及治疗意义——叙述性综述
items.abstractZh: 中轴型脊柱关节炎（axSpA）的性别差异正逐渐被认为具有临床意义，但仍未充分纳入诊断实践和结局评估。尽管长期以来被视为主要影响男性的疾病，axSpA在女性中的发病率几乎相当，且常呈现不同的表型。这些差异不仅限于严重程度的变化，还似乎反映了疾病不同的生物学和临床表达。女性axSpA患者通常报告更高水平的疼痛、疲劳和疾病活动度，同时常伴有较低的炎症标志物和较慢的影像学进展。她们还经历更长的诊断延迟，并更常出现外周表现或纤维肌痛等重叠性疼痛状况。相比之下，男性更常表现出典型的轴向表型、C反应蛋白升高和更严重的结构损伤。症状负担与客观炎症之间的这种不一致给疾病评估带来了挑战，因为传统工具在不同性别间的表现可能并不一致。新出现的证据还表明，治疗反应和药物持续使用方面存在性别相关差异。将性别视为疾病表达的生物学决定因素，而非仅仅是统计调整的协变量，为改进诊断精确性、优化结局解读以及支持更个体化的患者护理提供了机会。

items.title: Rheumatoid Arthritis Presenting with Multivalvular Regurgitation, Conduction Block, and Multisite Aneurysms: A Case Report With Histologic Confirmation.
items.abstract: Cardiac involvement in rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is uncommon and often clinically silent, but may encompass valvular, structural, and conduction system abnormalities. Involvement of the mitral-aortic intervalvular fibrosa (MAIVF) and the membranous interventricular septum is exceptionally rare and has not been previously described in RA. A 61-year-old man with longstanding seropositive RA presented with syncope due to intermittent complete atrioventricular block. Multimodality imaging revealed severe degenerative mitral regurgitation, moderate-to-severe aortic regurgitation, a pseudoaneurysm of the MAIVF extending into the left ventricular outflow tract, and a membranous interventricular septal aneurysm. Infective and congenital etiologies were excluded by repeated negative blood cultures, 18F-FDG PET, and comprehensive imaging. The patient underwent successful surgical mitral and aortic valve replacement. Histopathological analysis demonstrated rheumatoid nodules within both excised valves, confirming immune-mediated valvular involvement. Persistent conduction abnormalities required permanent pacemaker implantation. This report describes the first documented case of a MAIVF pseudoaneurysm in a patient with RA, associated with multivalvular disease and high-grade conduction disturbance. The findings highlight the potential for severe, atypical cardiac manifestations of RA in the absence of active systemic inflammation and underscore the pivotal role of multimodality imaging and multidisciplinary evaluation in establishing diagnosis and guiding management.

items.titleZh: 类风湿关节炎表现为多瓣膜反流、传导阻滞和多部位动脉瘤：一例经组织学确诊的病例报告
items.abstractZh: 类风湿关节炎（RA）的心脏受累并不常见，且常无临床症状，但可能涉及瓣膜、结构和传导系统异常。二尖瓣-主动脉瓣间纤维体（MAIVF）和膜部室间隔受累极为罕见，此前在RA中未见报道。一名61岁男性，患有长期血清阳性RA，因间歇性完全性房室传导阻滞导致晕厥就诊。多模态影像学检查显示重度退行性二尖瓣反流、中重度主动脉瓣反流、延伸至左心室流出道的MAIVF假性动脉瘤，以及膜部室间隔动脉瘤。反复血培养阴性、18F-FDG PET及全面影像学检查排除了感染性和先天性病因。患者成功接受了外科二尖瓣和主动脉瓣置换术。组织病理学分析显示两个切除瓣膜内均有类风湿结节，证实了免疫介导的瓣膜受累。持续性传导异常需要永久性起搏器植入。本报告描述了首例RA患者MAIVF假性动脉瘤的病例，并伴有瓣膜多发性疾病和高度传导障碍。这些发现强调了在无活动性全身性炎症的情况下RA可能出现的严重非典型心脏表现，并凸显了多模态影像学和多学科评估在确立诊断和指导治疗中的关键作用。

items.title: Distinct T Cell Repertoires in Spinal Entheses and Synovial Fluids in Ankylosing Spondylitis.
items.abstract: Ankylosing spondylitis (AS) is a chronic inflammatory condition primarily impacting the spine and sacroiliac joints, driven by immune dysregulation. While T cells are known contributors to AS, the specific cellular and molecular changes within affected tissues, especially in the spine, remain to be fully elucidated. We conducted single-cell RNA (scRNA-seq) and T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing on synovial fluids and spinal ligament samples from AS patients, supplemented by public AS and healthy control data. The analysis identified nine T cell clusters, with CD8 + memory T cells enriched in spine ligaments (SL), while mucosal-associated invariant T lymphocytes (MAIT) cells and regulatory T lymphocytes (Tregs) were enriched in synovial fluids. Differential expression and pathway analyses revealed that senescence-related genes, such as calmodulin 1 ( CALM1 ) and cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor 1A ( CDKN1A ), were enriched in SL, suggesting the presence of senescent T cells, and cytotoxic genes, including natural killer cell granule protein 7 ( NKG7 ), were enriched in synovial fluids. Furthermore, TCR repertoire analysis uncovered biased usage of T cell receptor gamma variable ( TRGV ) genes in SL and T cell receptor beta variable 9 ( TRBV9 ) in synovial fluid, indicating tissue-specific clonal expansion. Lastly, peptide prediction identified potential human leukocyte antigen-B27 (HLA-B27)-presented peptides, highlighting their contribution to inflammation. Our study demonstrates a unique immune landscape in AS, characterized by differential clonal expansion in peripheral and axial joints. These findings underscore T cell-mediated immune responses in AS pathology, contributing to the understanding of the immunological mechanisms of AS and potential immune-focused therapies. The online version contains supplementary material available at 10.1007/s43657-025-00292-z.

items.titleZh: 强直性脊柱炎脊柱附着点与滑液中不同的T细胞库
items.abstractZh: 强直性脊柱炎（AS）是一种主要影响脊柱和骶髂关节的慢性炎症性疾病，由免疫失调驱动。虽然已知T细胞是AS的贡献因素，但受累组织（尤其是脊柱）内具体的细胞和分子变化仍未完全阐明。我们对AS患者的滑液和脊柱韧带样本进行了单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）和T细胞受体（TCR）测序，并辅以公共AS和健康对照数据。分析确定了九个T细胞簇，其中CD8+记忆T细胞在脊柱韧带（SL）中富集，而黏膜相关恒定T淋巴细胞（MAIT）细胞和调节性T淋巴细胞（Tregs）在滑液中富集。差异表达和通路分析显示，衰老相关基因，如钙调蛋白1（CALM1）和细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶抑制剂1A（CDKN1A），在SL中富集，提示存在衰老T细胞；而细胞毒性基因，包括自然杀伤细胞颗粒蛋白7（NKG7），在滑液中富集。此外，TCR库分析揭示了SL中T细胞受体γ可变（TRGV）基因和滑液中T细胞受体β可变9（TRBV9）的偏向性使用，表明组织特异性克隆扩增。最后，肽预测确定了潜在的人白细胞抗原-B27（HLA-B27）呈递肽，强调其促进炎症的作用。我们的研究展示了AS中独特的免疫景观，其特征在于外周和轴向关节中差异性的克隆扩增。这些发现强调了T细胞介导的免疫反应在AS病理中的作用，有助于理解AS的免疫学机制及潜在的免疫靶向治疗。在线版本包含补充材料，可在10.1007/s43657-025-00292-z获取。

items.title: [Thoracobifemoral bypass surgery with replacement of visceral arteries in a patient with nonspecific aortoarteritis].
items.abstract: The authors present a rare case of severe symptomatic involvement of multiple vessels in a young female patient with nonspecific aortoarteritis (Takayasu's disease). She underwent thoracobifemoral bypass grafting, replacement of superior mesenteric artery and both renal arteries, as well as left-sided carotid artery replacement with reconstruction of external and internal carotid arteries. Surgical procedure, early and late postoperative periods are described. Furthermore, current approaches to diagnosis and treatment of nonspecific aortoarteritis are discussed. The authors analyze potential complications of open and endovascular correction of steno-occlusive lesions associated with Takayasu's disease. Описан редкий случай тяжелого симптомного поражения нескольких сосудистых бассейнов у молодой пациентки с неспецифическим аортоартериитом (болезнь Такаясу). По этому поводу ей было выполнено торако-бибедренное шунтирование, протезирование верхней брыжеечной артерии и обеих почечных артерий, протезосонное протезирование слева с реконструкцией наружной и внутренней сонных артерий. Описан ход операции, а также ранний и отдаленный послеоперационные периоды. Кроме того, рассмотрены современные подходы к диагностике и лечению неспецифического аортоартериита, а также возможные осложнения открытых и эндоваскулярных методик при хирургической коррекции стеноокклюзирующих поражений при болезни Такаясу.

items.titleZh: 非特异性主动脉炎患者行胸腹主动脉双股动脉旁路移植术并置换内脏动脉
items.abstractZh: 作者报道了一例年轻女性非特异性主动脉炎（高安病）患者多个血管床严重症状性受累的罕见病例。患者接受了胸主动脉-双股动脉旁路移植术、肠系膜上动脉及双肾动脉置换术，以及左侧颈动脉置换术并重建颈外动脉和颈内动脉。本文描述了手术过程、早期及远期术后情况。此外，还讨论了非特异性主动脉炎诊断和治疗的当前方法。作者分析了与高安病相关的狭窄闭塞性病变开放及血管内矫正的潜在并发症。
